title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning, Geo
desc:
Define the multi-year ML direction, modeling roadmap, and shared objectives and key results with partners while leading, mentoring, and growing a team of engineers.
 Architect and optimize sub-second ML/Large Language Models (LLM) inference and agentic reasoning loops enabling real-time intent resolution, adaptive follow-up questioning, and moderation transparency.
 Lead the transition from fragmented models to unified joint-modeling architectures.
 Advocate scalable evaluation frameworks spanning structured facts and unstructured claims, active learning pipelines, and synthetic data generation to maximize model performance.
 Cultivate engineering excellence across the organization. Minimum qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
 8 years of experience in software development.
 5 years of experience with ML design and end-to-end Machine Learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).
 5 years of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.
 Experience in a technical leadership role, managing a team of engineers.
 Experience with Generative AI (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), diffusion models), development workflows, and use cases.
 Preferred qualifications: 
 Master's degree or PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
 Experience designing automated evaluation frameworks and experimentation for generative AI and ML systems.
 Experience in one or more adjacent domains including Content Moderation, Conversational AI, Multimodal Fusion, or Truth Synthesis systems.
 Experience in people management within cross-functional environments.
 Ability to align and influence stakeholders across multiple engineering, product, and operations organizations. Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

title: Research Scientist, Agents, DeepMind
desc:
Design, implement, and evaluate models, agents, and software prototypes of large foundational models.
 Push the boundary of reinforcement learning and ML optimization methods to build autonomous agents.
 Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing.
 Suggest and engage in team and external collaborations, maintaining relationships with relevant research labs.
 Work in collaboration with our Responsible AI teams to ensure our advances in intelligence are developed ethically and provide broad benefits to humanity. Minimum qualifications: 
 PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 8 years of experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch).
 Experience with advanced deep learning and reinforcement learning.
 Publication record in machine learning conferences or journals (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, AAAI).
 Preferred qualifications: 
 Experience with multimodal learning, large language models, or assistive AI agents.
 Experience with prompt engineering, few-shot learning, post-training techniques, and evaluations.
 Familiarity with model training and deployment.
 Strong programming skills in Python or similar languages.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills. The Agents team at Deepmind India is driven by the mission of developing foundational capabilities in Large Models towards realizing Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). We focus on uncovering emergent agentic behaviors through novel reinforcement learning algorithms run at scale.
 We also apply our research advances to Gemini and critical product launches in Google, touching the lives of hundreds of millions of users, and we are looking forward to doing more! 
We are seeking a highly motivated and Research Scientist to join our team in Bengaluru, focused on advancing in autonomous agents through reinforcement learning and ML optimization methods.
In this role, you will conduct research on large language models (LLMs), focusing on the development of more capable autonomous agents. You will lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of solving and building Artificial General Intelligence. You will work collaboratively within and across Research fields, and will develop solutions to fundamental questions in machine learning and AI. Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

title: Post-Doctoral Researcher, PhD, DeepMind, 2026 Start (Fixed-Term Contract)
desc:
Work with research mentors to formulate research projects or novel applications of machine learning aligned with the team's mission. Conduct research and publish high quality work.
 Design and execute large-scale experiments, writing high-quality, reusable code, and contributing to a production-ready system using frameworks such as JAX. Learn and understand research in machine learning algorithms.
 Understand how to use research to drive design decisions. Design and conduct user studies (e.g. interviews, surveys, controlled experiments, and field deployments) to understand how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to AI agents.
 Prototype novel interfaces and interaction techniques that help people steer, supervise, and collaborate with increasingly autonomous agents. Develop human-centered evaluation methods and metrics for the helpfulness, trustworthiness, safety, and alignment of agents.
 Translate insights from human studies into improvements in how agents learn from human feedback and improve themselves (e.g. reward modeling, preference elicitation, and human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning). Minimum qualifications: 
 PhD degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
 Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc. and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
 Research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g., open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
 One or more scientific publication submission(s) in AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, ICLR).
 Preferred qualifications: PhD and Master’s degree in a STEM field (e.g. Computer Science, Mathematics, or Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.
 Hands-on experience with one or more general purpose programming languages: Python, C/C++, or Java, etc and training deep learning models in frameworks such as JAX, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
 Extensive research experience in machine learning or AI techniques (e.g. open source project(s), campus lab experience, research internship(s), or publication(s)).
 Ability to work and collaborate across multiple teams and work with ambiguity.
 A strong publication record in top-tier conferences/journals. The Post-doctoral Researcher role is a 12 to 24-month role designed to explore challenging problems for pushing frontiers of AI, while collaborating with DeepMind scientists and engineers. Your role will entail conducting human-computer interaction (HCI) research on how people interact with, oversee, and provide feedback to increasingly autonomous AI agents, designing and building novel interfaces and interaction techniques for human-agent collaboration, and evaluating them through rigorous user studies. Insights from your work will inform how agents learn from human feedback and remain safe and aligned with human intent, with potential application to products that might have a positive impact on billions of users.
 At DeepMind, we're a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence, and fulfill our mission of building AI responsibility to benefit humanity. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical challenges, ensuring safety and ethics are the highest priority. 
 In particular, our AQUA team at DeepMind India works at the frontier of AI agents, focusing on autonomous self-improvement, reinforcement learning, and the safety and alignment of agents. We build agents that continually improve themselves by learning from their own experience, interactions, and feedback, and we develop methods to ensure that increasingly capable and autonomous agents remain safe, reliable, and aligned with human intent and values. We aim to bring our research into Google's cutting-edge models and products, while also disseminating our findings through publications at top ML conferences/journals.

 Experience with Performance Optimization, Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) Programming, High Performance Computing, Large Language Model, Open Source Contributor.

Experience with ML Inference frameworks such as vLLM, SG Lang, Pathways and in open-source software development, including experience in releasing and supporting open-source projects. Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
 Our team is focused around driving continuous improvements to the machine learning software/hardware stacks through providing insightful performance debugging for workloads and custom kernels. We provide insights by summarizing different views of captured profile data - such as trace timelines, memory usage, Compiler profiles, ML graph summaries
 The ML, Systems, & Cloud AI (MSCA) organization at Google designs, implements, and manages the hardware, software, machine learning, and systems infrastructure for all Google services (Search, YouTube, etc.) and Google Cloud. Our end users are Googlers, Cloud customers and the billions of people who use Google services around the world.

Our global impact spans software and hardware, including Google Cloud’s Vertex AI, the leading AI platform for bringing Gemini models to enterprise customers.

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including coding experience in Python and SQL.
 Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, Data Catalog, and AlloyDB).
 Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, including architecting data systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
 Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.
 Preferred qualifications: 
 Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
 Knowledge of large language model (LLM)-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.
 Experience in prompt developing, model evaluation, and the creative application of AI.
 Experience building applications on LLM over enterprise data (e.g., Gemini, agents, RAG, vector search) and evaluating them for quality, latency and cost.
 Experience migrating analytics, Spark or database workloads between platforms with measured cost or performance outcomes. Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on the Data Cloud team, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. You will function as an "innovator-builder," working directly within customers’ environments to move data and machine learning workloads from idea to production on Google Cloud, leveraging experience with programming languages (e.g. PySpark, SQL, Python) and the data cloud ecosystem (e.g. BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB). You will build the data foundations that agents depend on, and train and evaluate machine learning models on customer data. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.
 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

desc:
Revolutionize Machine Learning (ML) workload characterization and benchmarking, and propose capabilities and optimizations for next-generation TPUs.
 Develop architecture specifications that meet current and future computing requirements for AI/ML roadmap. Develop architectural and microarchitectural power/performance models, microarchitecture and RTL designs and evaluate quantitative and qualitative performance and power analysis.
 Partner with hardware design, software, compiler, Machine Learning (ML) model and research teams for effective hardware/software codesign, creating high performance hardware/software interfaces.
 Develop and adopt advanced AI/ML capabilities, drive accelerated and efficient design verification strategies and implementations.
 Use AI techniques for faster and optimal physical design convergence -timing, floor planning, power grid and clock tree design etc. Investigate, validate, and optimize DFT, post-silicon test, and debug strategies, contributing to the advancement of silicon bring-up and qualification processes. Minimum qualifications: 
 PhD degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Experience in programming languages (e.g., C++, Python, Verilog), Synopsys, Cadence tools.
 Experience with accelerator architectures and data center workloads.
 Preferred qualifications: 
 2 years of experience in Silicon domain post PhD.
 Experience with performance modeling tools.
 Knowledge of arithmetic units, bus architectures, accelerators, or memory hierarchies.
 Knowledge of high performance and low power design techniques. In this role, you will shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration as a Silicon Architect/Design Engineer and drive TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that fuels Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You will collaborate with hardware and software architects and designers to architect, model, analyze, define and design next-generation TPUs. You will have dynamic, multi-faceted responsibilities in areas such as product definition, design, and implementation, collaborating with the Engineering teams to drive the optimal balance between performance, power, features, schedule, and cost.
 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

title: Senior SoC Design Verification Engineer, Google Cloud
desc:
Plan the verification of digital design blocks and interact with design engineers to identify important verification scenarios. 
 Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases. 
 Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks. 
 Measure to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out. 
 Create a constrained-random verification environment using SystemVerilog and Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). Minimum qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 8 years of experience in Verification, verifying digital logic at RTL level using SystemVerilog or Specman/E for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) or ASICs.
 Experience in verification and debug of IP/subsystem/SoCs in the Networking domain such as packet processing, bandwidth management, congestion control desired.
 Experience verifying digital systems using standard IP components/interconnects (e.g., microprocessor cores, hierarchical memory subsystems).
 Preferred qualifications: 
 Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture.
 Experience with industry-standard simulators, revision control systems, and regression systems.
 Experience in Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) Accelerators or vector processing units.
 Experience with the full verification life cycle.
 Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. In this role, you will own the full verification life-cycle from verification planning and test execution to coverage closure, with an emphasis on meeting stringent AI/ML performance and accuracy goals, build constrained-random verification environments capable of exposing corner-case bugs and ensuring the reliability of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) workloads on Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) hardware. You will reuse what already works at Amazon scale, partner with its engineers and scientists, and use that head start to make EU OAS bigger, faster.
The problems are new and hard. Your team will build catalog, discovery and commerce systems that take in product information in many formats and levels of quality, decide what is accurate and eligible to show customers, match it to the Amazon catalog, and help customers discover, evaluate and buy it. 
If you want to build a team and a customer facing product from the start across 10 EU Stores, with the newest AI and a large platform behind you, we would love to talk to you.

- Hire, develop and lead the founding team, and set a high bar for every engineer you hire and grow.
- Own the technical vision, roadmap and architecture for your team's catalog, discovery and commerce systems, from the first launches to scale across Amazon's European stores.
- Build and run production systems that use large language models and AI at internet scale.
- Run the team AI-native from day one, with engineers using AI coding agents across design, coding, testing and operations.

A day in the life
You might start the day reviewing the design for a service that checks product data for a new European store, then join a working session with scientists on how a large language model should match products to the Amazon catalog across languages. You will weigh in on architectural trade-offs, and sequence a multi-quarter roadmap against ambiguous requirements. You will invest in your people through 1:1s, career conversations, hiring, and coaching. In the afternoon you hold one-on-ones and a hiring debrief, and review experiment results with product and science partners worldwide.

EU OAS sits in the larger Localization team that makes Amazon's selection available to customers in their own language across Amazon's stores. Our program and operations teams already work in Hyderabad, and our engineering, science and product teams work from Luxembourg, Paris and other European cities. title: Research Scientist II, Grocery ECO
desc:

We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. title: Senior Manager, Applied Science, Amazon Business System Integrations
desc:
Are you energized by building technology that makes life easier for business customers? If you enjoy working at the center of enterprise commerce, connecting Amazon Business with the procurement, ERP, and finance systems that organizations run on ethn Amazon Business System (ABS) Integrations team is the place for you.
We build systems integrations capabilities that let business customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. This includes APIs, protocols, and partner connections that make procurement faster, more automated, and more reliable at global scale. Our teams design, launch, and operates these integrations with a wide range of partners, and each launch has to work securely and seamlessly across many different systems, regions, and customer needs.
We are seeking a Senior Manager Applied Science to build and lead the science organization in Amazon Business Systems Integrations. This is a foundational leadership role spanning the full integrations portfolio. This role will hire, grow, and lead a team of applied scientists who define how we measure and improve the performance of AI agents and human-AI teams. A core part of the role is defining the science agenda itself - identifying which problems are most worth solving and where the highest-leverage bets lie. Directions worth exploring might include Organizational Intelligence (turning institutional knowledge into agent-consumable skills) AI Agent Experience / AiAX (agent observability and autonomous remediation) and contextual behavioral security that adapts enforcement in real time for human and agent sessions and anything which the defines how we measure and improve agents and human-AI teams i.e benchmarks, task suites, and metrics (accuracy cost-per-task task completion productivity) that turn subjective "it works" judgments into rigorous reproducible measurement that gates what we ship. There are no established industry patterns in this field and the team will set the scientific direction, determine how AI agents and people perceive reason and act reliably within computing environments at enterprise scale.
This role requires building, leading and retaining a high calibre applied science team spanning the Agentic Integrations portfolio. This leader will set the bar for scientific talent, create the growth paths, and build the culture that makes Amazon Business a destination for the best agent and human-AI researchers.
Key job responsibilities
• Set the long-term scientific vision and team strategy: Define what best-in-class agent performance evaluation and learning look like across Agentic WorkSpaces - for computer-using agents and human-AI teams alike. Chart a multi-year research roadmap and build the team and plan to deliver it. Secure buy-in from VP-level leadership.
• Hire and grow scientific talent: Own recruiting calibration development and retention for the science team. Mentor scientists toward senior and principal scope and raise the scientific bar across the organization.
• Direct research on highly ambiguous novel problems: Guide the team through foundational challenges in agent perception reasoning evaluation reliability and human-AI collaboration - problems where neither the approach nor the success criteria are pre-defined.
• Drive cross-organizational alignment: Work across partner teams (AgentCore Bedrock model teams Identity Security the MCP ecosystem) and across the Applied AI Solutions product portfolio with product and engineering leadership to ensure scientific decisions compose into a coherent product.
• Deliver measurable business impact: Ensure your team's research translates to customer outcomes: higher task accuracy lower cost-per-action faster time-to-production measurable productivity for human-AI teams and the trust that lets enterprises scale agent workflows.
• Establish scientific rigor and operational excellence: Set the standard for experimentation evaluation and reproducibility and the mechanisms that keep the science organization productive and accountable.
• Advance the state of the art: Enable and champion contributions to the external technical community through publications patents and open-source work that position AWS as the leader in the science of secure agent-computer interaction and human-AI teamwork.
• Translate science into shipped product. Partner with engineering, product, and program leaders to move models evaluation and learning systems from prototype into a decade-old production service operating at massive scale without compromising the reliability that customers depend on.
• Represent science in leadership and to customers. Be the scientific voice in org-level planning and roadmap decisions across AAWS and engage directly with enterprise customers on how agent performance safety and human-AI productivity are measured and earned.

title: Software Development Engineer, WW Returns and Recommerce
desc:
Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns and ReCommerce team (WWR&R) at Amazon.com.
WW R&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon and send Zero product waste to landfill “the 3 Zeros”. We do this by developing products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned & damaged product value, and create the best customer returns experience in the world.
Amazon WW R&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using C++, Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.
We are looking for software engineers with 4+ years of solid Software engineering experience involving solving complex problems. They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
Amazon is earth’s most customer-centric company and through WW R&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns & ReCommerce team!

2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

desc:

This charter sits at the intersection of machine learning, real-time decisioning, and customer lifecycle strategy - and is responsible for determining which customers to engage, with what action, at what moment, and through which channel.

Our north star is moving customers from occasional buyers to loyal, high-frequency shoppers.
We build and scale programs including Gamified Experiences, Rewards, Promotions Orchestration, and Personalization - reaching millions of customers across our fast growing marketplaces. desc:

We would prefer if your previous work has been in developing scalable Agentic, RL or forecasting systems. Strong academic background in Statistics, Machine Learning & Deep Learning is required with Tier -1 publications being a plus.

You will work with global leaders and teams across time zones on a regular basis. 
About the team
Millions of Sellers list their products for sale on the Amazon Marketplace. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices. In this ecosystem our team plays a critical role in enabling Sellers across EU5, China, Japan, Australia, Brazil and Turkey to make their Selection available to customers globally and deliver the experience they have come to expect from Amazon.
In Jeff’s own words (2019 Q1 shareholders letter): “Something strange and remarkable has happened over the last 20 years. Take a look at these numbers: 1999 - 3% …… 2018 - 58%. There isn't one answer, but we do know one extremely important part of the answer: We helped independent sellers compete against our first-party business by investing in and offering them the very best selling tools we could imagine and build.

title: Mgr, Quality/Training Strategy, GO-AI Operations Integration
desc:
The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality.
As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output.
- Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces.
- Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality.
- Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation.
- Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output.
- Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience.
- Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure.
About the team
GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. We combine human expertise with machine learning to produce high-quality training data, validate model outputs, and continuously improve AI system performance across many annotation programs and a large global workforce. title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
desc:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.
You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners. 
Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
- Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.
About the team
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
desc:
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly. 
The Mission
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.
What You'll Build
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.
Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.
This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily.
But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. But here's what makes this role truly special: you'll shape the future. You'll design multi-agent architectures where distributed AI systems exhibit emergent collective intelligence while maintaining human oversight and control. Every innovation you drive—from consensus-driven reasoning frameworks to sophisticated orchestration patterns—will set new standards for trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.

title: Risk Analyst II, Account Integrity
desc:
Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. The Risk Mining function is where human ingenuity meets machine learning - our team detects emerging modus operandi (MOs) that automated systems alone can't catch, and feeds those signals back into scalable upstream defenses. Nowhere is that fight sharper than in Anti-Automation, where we go head-to-head with bots, scripted attacks, and automated abuse that evolves by the hour. If you want to do investigative work that directly translates into customer trust at global scale, this is the role.
The Risk Analyst II (Risk Mining) is a senior individual-contributor role that sits at the intersection of three disciplines - analyst, strategist, and ML partner. You will join the Anti-Automation Risk Mining team in India - a team of analysts, investigators, and builders who hunt down automated abuse before it scales. As the analyst, you run deep dives on bot and scripted-attack behavior and turn raw signal into high-quality MO documentation. As the strategist, you shape where the vertical invests its detection effort and anticipate how the adversary will evolve. As the ML partner, you work hand-in-hand with Machine Learning and Engineering to convert your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses and close the feedback loop into models and rules.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with broad cross-team influence, reporting to Risk Mining leadership. You are accountable for the quality, speed, and impact of your investigations - detecting automated MOs, driving measurable gains in detection speed and precision, mitigating risk, and clearing the blockers that stand between the team and impact. As a senior IC, you are expected to raise the bar for investigation quality across the vertical and influence detection strategy well beyond your own caseload.
Key job responsibilities
- Lead complex investigations into emerging automated abuse - running deep dives on bots, scripted attacks, and automated MOs before they scale, and setting the quality bar others follow.
- Own detection and mitigation strategy for the Anti-Automation vertical - prioritizing the highest-risk automated MOs and anticipating how bots and scripted attacks will evolve.
- Partner deeply with Machine Learning and Engineering teams to turn your findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.
- Translate investigative signal into ML features, detection logic, and rule improvements - acting as the bridge between front-line investigation and automated defense.
- Produce high-quality deep dives, MO write-ups, and analyses, and own vertical-level metrics for detection volume, speed, and precision.
- Collaborate with the other Risk Mining verticals and partner teams (Payment Risk, Abuse Risk Mining) on joint investigations and shared signals.
- Serve as a subject-matter expert on high-severity incidents and escalations.
- Champion automation and GenAI opportunities to amplify throughput and quality, and measure the realized ROI from those investments.
A day in the life
No two days look the same when the automated-abuse landscape shifts in real time - your week balances hands-on investigation, strategy, and close ML partnership to keep Anti-Automation ahead of emerging threats:
Analyst (Investigation & Analysis)
- Running deep dives on the highest-risk automated MOs and following the signal in the noise and take mitigation action. 
- Pulling and analyzing large datasets to size impact, confirm hypotheses, and sharpen detection.
- Documenting findings and MO write-ups so they can be turned into durable, scalable defenses.
Strategy (Building What's Next)
- Shaping the detection and mitigation strategy for your slice of Risk Mining - anticipating how automated abuse will evolve and positioning the team to stay ahead.
- Championing GenAI and automation opportunities as a core part of the vertical's strategy.
ML Partnership (Scaling the Defense)
- Partnering with ML and Engineering to turn your findings into automated defenses that scale.
- Translating investigative signal into features, detection logic, and rule improvements.
- Owning the feedback loop so model and rule performance keeps improving on the MOs you surface.
Tactical (Keeping the Engine Running)
- Reporting detection metrics and progress on key goals.
- Responding to live escalations when a new automated attack surfaces.
About the team
The Risk Mining team within Account Integrity spans India, US, and Costa Rica, and works for Amazon's worldwide marketplace to detect and disrupt bad-actor behavior.
Our mission is simple: find the signal in the noise before bad actors cause harm. We operate across three risk verticals - Anti-Automation, Account Takeover, and Bad Actor Account - and partner closely with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn our investigative findings into scalable upstream defenses. The Anti-Automation vertical sits at the front line of that fight, taking on bots and scripted abuse at the scale.
If you want to do work where your findings directly translate into customer trust at global scale - and where the adversary never stops evolving - this is the team. Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects
- 5+ years of experience in an analytics or data-driven role (e.g. business analyst, risk analyst, data analyst, operations analyst, or research analyst) or similar quantitative/analytical roles across any domain Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience

title: Manager I, Investigations, Relay Product Excellence
desc:
Managers – Investigations (RPE) set the direction and culture of their teams within a defined strategy by managing individual and team performance expectations and goals, providing individual coaching feedback sessions and weekly one-on-ones that focus on making Amazon's transportation platforms safer to transact, improving customer satisfaction, monitoring real-time service levels and schedule adherence, and serving as the point of contact for escalated investigation resolution of a supervisory nature.
The incumbent manages a team of L2–L3 Investigation Specialists who conduct risk reviews on drivers and accounts to protect Amazon from fraud, abuse, and account takeover, and who take appropriate actions based on processes, tools, and high-judgment decisions. This is a direct-supervisory role over individual contributors; the incumbent does not manage managers, and the number of reports is determined by their manager.
Operating in an area with established procedures and a predictable workflow, the incumbent provides tactical management, makes sound decisions within the team's defined strategy, and seeks direction and coaching from their manager as they continue to develop their management skills. In addition to achieving and exceeding the team's defined metrics through sustainable change or process improvement, she/he participates in project road-mapping activities, identifies trends in team performance, and recommends/implements change to constantly raise performance levels. The key to success in this role is the ability to understand the RPE group's vision and manage the team toward attaining it.
Performance Areas
Metrics — Consistently lead the team to meet and exceed service levels and targets in reducing risk-related losses and fraud, and maintain the performance and metrics of all team members (and hence the team) at expected levels. Audit work queues and SLA adherence, and report through Metrics, Service Level Agreements, and Key Performance Indicators. Contribute to forecasting accuracy and the staffing requirements needed to achieve SLAs, partnering with program and leadership stakeholders.
Process Improvement — Recommend improvements to tools and procedures for operational excellence, and deliver business impact through improvements to quality, productivity, or customer experience. Help identify and eliminate root causes of defects to drive efficiency in Amazon's transportation operations, escalating roadblocks and risks as appropriate. Work with peer technical teams to articulate and prioritize feature needs for investigation tool sets.
People Development — Develop the performance, careers, and skills of the investigator team through continuous closure of performance feedback loops. Specifically, the incumbent:
Attracts and hires bar-raising talent, working with their manager to get the necessary training and support to continuously raise the bar on candidates.
Guides the onboarding process for new hires using existing onboarding materials/plans that maximize rapid exposure and skill development.
Is able to explain Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Holds career-growth conversations to recognize strengths, provide constructive feedback on opportunity areas, and align work to areas of interest; helps employees define short- and mid-term development goals, identifies opportunities to meet them, and updates goals as priorities change.
Evaluates employees against the appropriate role guidelines/level expectations, participates in calibration activities with their manager, and is learning to seek performance information from multiple sources. Communicates in regular 1:1s how performance is evaluated and how each employee is performing.
Discusses promotion with leadership when an employee consistently demonstrates next-level performance in a next-level-scoped role.

title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon

We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross-organizationally. title: Software Development Manager, AWS Just Walk Out
desc:
As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use. 
Just Walk Out builds technology enables a new kind of stores with no lines and no checkout—you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!
Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware.
As a Software Development Manager, you will own delivery of cross functional initiatives to build new features and improve Just Walk Out experience. You will manage a team of 6-10 software development engineers to build and enhance the shopping experience in Just Walk out stores.
Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an individual that thrives by creating high-bar engineering culture. You’ll be chartered with building software that deliver critical capabilities to our AWS Just Walk out business enabling bar raising customer experience, embed operational knowledge and encode best practices into everything we do.

Beyond a strong engineering, data storage/modeling, visualization, and front-end background, a successful candidate will have experience successfully leading teams, developing people, and building a scalable infrastructure. We are looking for someone that is a self-starter, someone that approaches complex business questions with data and curiosity, and a person that dives below the surface to identify the root cause and "so what" rather than just superficial trends
About the team
Just Walk Out (JWO) is an AWS technology that eliminates checkout lines using computer vision, sensors, & AI. JWO operates across multiple countries, spanning stadiums, airports, college campuses, & Amazon fulfillment centers. We run multiple business models - including vision-based stores & RFID checkout - & we're growing fast. As we scale into new markets & verticals, we're deploying LLMs for shopper support, building AI agents that can operate autonomously, & re-architecting our platform to serve multiple businesses across countries with varying tax, privacy, & regulatory requirements.

That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, & other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. title: Business Intelligent Engineer II, Amazon Shipping
desc:
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. With a scale of millions of packages, each with different attributes and delivery requirements, what results is a highly dense graph of nodes.
We have built a highly respected BI and Data Engineering team which is focused on solving complex problems in worldwide transportation using workflows, optimization algorithms, and machine learning systems. These are large-scale distributed systems handling millions of packages being shipped through the Amazon logistics network.
As a Business Intelligence Engineer, you will develop datasets, dashboards, reports, and visualizations using BI tools, and provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic planning within Amazon Shipping. Additionally, you will deliver across planned projects that will improve overall cost and profitability for the business.
Key job responsibilities
- Data Management and Integration: Collect, process, and manage large datasets from various sources, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and accessibility.
- Data Analysis: Analyze complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can inform business decisions.
- Reporting and Visualization: Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations to present data insights in an understandable and actionable format.
- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with stakeholders to understand their data needs, provide data-driven recommendations, and support strategic planning.
- Tool and Technology Utilization: Utilize and stay updated with the latest BI tools and technologies to enhance data analysis and reporting capabilities. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience in Statistical Analysis packages such as R, SAS and Matlab
- Experience using SQL to pull data from a database or data warehouse and scripting experience (Python) to process data for modeling Preferred qualifications: - Experience with AWS solutions such as EC2, DynamoDB, S3, and Redshift
- Experience in data mining, ETL, etc. and using databases in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

1. Address business challenges through building compelling cases and using data to influence change across the organization
2. Develop input and assumptions based on preexisting models to estimate costs and savings opportunities associated with varying levels of network growth and operations

Extensive experience in operations research and data-driven decision making

Customer-obsessed mindset with a focus on improving the Amazon delivery experience

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement sophisticated machine learning models for logistics optimization
Develop complex time series forecasting algorithms for demand prediction and resource allocation

Architect and deploy AI-powered systems to enhance decision-making in logistics operations

title: Manager II, Risk Mining, Account Integrity
desc:
Amazon's Account Integrity Team (AIT) within Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) protects hundreds of millions of customers by identifying and stopping fraudulent activity before it causes harm. - Partner with Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to turn your team's findings into scalable, automated upstream defenses, and own the feedback loop back into models and rules.

A day in the life

People & Leadership

title: SDE II, Ship With Amazon, Ship With Amazon
desc:
Amazon’s global fulfillment network enables any merchant to ship items that are ordered on Amazon to any place on earth. There is a complex network of ways in which items move between vendor locations, Amazon warehouses, and customer locations as well as several intermediate locations through which packages travel before reaching the customer. title: System Development Engineer - EdgeAI, HW Compute Group
desc:
Are you passionate about running large AI models directly on consumer devices — where every millisecond, milliwatt, and megabyte matters? Join our team to work at the core of the Neural Network Accelerator (NNA) software stack, driving on-device machine-learning inference, compiler and runtime development, and the automation infrastructure that ships production-quality AI features to millions of Amazon devices.
Key job responsibilities
As a SysDE I on the NNA / EdgeAI team, you will contribute to the software stack that compiles, deploys, and runs vision and language models on Amazon's in-house neural accelerators. You will work across the ML compilation pipeline (quantization, graph lowering, kernel selection, artifact packaging), the on-device inference runtime (secure and non-secure execution paths, memory and bandwidth budgets), and the release and validation infrastructure that keeps our device fleet healthy build over build.
A day in the life
You will help build and improve the test and evaluation systems that validate model accuracy, latency, memory footprint, and stability on physical devices in the lab — including large-scale evaluation of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) end-to-end from reference to device. You will also contribute to the build, release, and CI automation that keeps our multi-package software stack shipping cleanly across product platforms.
This role sits at the intersection of ML systems, embedded software, and release engineering. Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field
- Experience working in a Linux/Unix environment
- Strong programming skills in one or more of C, C++, Python
- Experience with automating, building, testing, or deploying software
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and multi-package release engineering Preferred qualifications: - Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals — model formats, quantization, inference vs training
- Experience with on-device or embedded ML runtimes, ML compilers, or accelerator toolchains
- Experience with device-side debugging: kernel logs, driver logs, ADB, on-device tracing
- Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS) for large-scale test execution, log storage, and metrics
- Familiarity with agent-based / AI-assisted developer tooling for triage, code review, or release automation
- Minimum 3 year of experience in ML systems, embedded software, or release engineering

title: Senior Fraud Investigator, Fraud Investigation, Recovery and Enforcement
desc:
Investigator, Retail Fraud Prevention
Summary
Join Amazon's Fraud Prevention team and help protect our financial systems by investigating and preventing fraudulent payments to suppliers and vendors globally. You'll work with sophisticated transactional data to identify emerging fraud schemes, lead complex investigations, and develop detection systems that stop fraud before it impacts our business.
About the Team
We are a collaborative team within Finance Operations dedicated to detecting and preventing fraudulent payments across Amazon's global operations. Our work is grounded in data—we use signals from invoices, payments, and transactional records to identify threats and emerging fraud schemes. We partner closely with colleagues in Accounts Payable, Finance, Legal, and technical support to stay ahead of risks and protect the integrity of our financial systems. Our vision is to build a fraud prevention program that evolves with emerging threats, and we're looking for someone who shares our commitment to this mission and can help us develop other investigators and strengthen our detection capabilities.
Key Job Responsibilities
Conduct thorough investigations into suspected fraudulent vendor payments, analyzing complex datasets and digital evidence to identify patterns and build comprehensive cases
Develop and implement detection systems and prototypes that identify new fraud schemes and prevent fraudulent payments from entering our financial system
Prepare detailed case summaries and evidence documentation with clear findings and recommendations for stakeholders, Legal, and law enforcement referrals
Communicate investigation results and strategic recommendations to senior leaders through periodic business reviews and updates
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline investigation processes, improve efficiency, and establish reporting systems that support investigation goals

Experience applying AI and machine learning to build detection mechanisms, automate investigation workflows, and reduce cycle time
Demonstrated ability to analyze large datasets and identify patterns indicative of fraud or financial irregularities
Strong written communication skills with the ability to document complex investigations clearly and concisely
Advanced use of Excel and statistical analysis applications, experience with Microsoft office including Outlook, Word and Excel
1+ years minimum experience with SQL
Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions

Masters degree or equivalent 
Knowledge of intermediate SQL
Background in financial crime investigation or forensic accounting
A day in the life
As an Investigator for Retail Fraud Prevention, you'll dive into complex financial data to uncover patterns that signal potential fraud, waste, or abuse in our vendor payment processes. Your day might include analyzing large datasets and digital evidence to build a compelling case, collaborating with colleagues across Finance, Legal, and technical teams to validate your findings, and presenting clear recommendations to senior leaders. You'll design new detection systems and refine investigation processes to improve how our team operates. This role sits at the intersection of data analysis and investigative work, where your insights directly influence how we protect Amazon's financial operations.

title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer, Shipping Tech & Services
desc:
Amazon Shipping is our externalized business providing small parcel transportation services to sellers and shippers. Amazon Shipping leverages many of the above foundational systems together with operations capabilities to pick up packages from shipper warehouses and inject them into the AFN outbound transportation network to provide an end-to-end parcel delivery product we can sell. 
The Sr. PE in this space will develop deep understanding of Amazon’s end-to-end fulfilment and transportation operations in order to support small-parcel transportation for all Amazon marketplaces, its subsidiaries, merchants and off-Amazon shippers. 
This role will need to understand not only how a large set of technical services within Carrier Integration Services (CIS) and Amazon Shipping work together, but also how they interface and enable the adjacent functions, capabilities and programs across First Mile, Middle Mile and Last Mile as we transition to being an end-to-end carrier. 
The Sr. PE will establish the strategy and execution plan to achieve convergence of multiple legacy systems in the carrier space, gracefully manage this transition while both legacy and new systems coexist in production, and strike the right balance between feature velocity and not blocking business launches yet also avoiding accrual of technical debt and throwaway work. 
To do this effectively requires setting a strategy that provides value in both the near and long-term, and aligning 5 to 6 VP stakeholders on the vision and plan. The Sr. PE must possess a broad and deep understanding of the transportation architecture and operations, and create scalable solutions to support heterogeneous functions at scale, such as FC package labeling and sorting, sort center processing, line haul, air and last mile delivery as well as an ever-growing number of programs (e.g., Sub-Same Day, AmazonDay, Roar, Pharmacy) and advanced capabilities (disruption management, replanning, problem solve, Redirect to Locker). 
The Sr. PE will need to understand not just the technical and product capabilities but the nuances of the businesses they are supporting, and helps to understand and balance conflicting stakeholder objectives, while simultaneously building trust and demonstrating empathy with their customers’ needs
Key job responsibilities
1. You lead the definition, design, architecture quality, implementation, and delivery of the most advanced, most difficult, most cross-cutting, and/or most ambiguous challenges spanning across ATS. You may own one or more critical components.
2. You ensure that the teams within ATS and teams in related organizations are aligned to a coherent technical vision and delivering systems that fit well together.
3. You exert influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness. You hold peers and teams to a high bar.
4. You are considered to be an authority on technical issues by both the technical and business community and are frequently consulted for making difficult trade-off decisions. You are respected for your technical expertise and have credibility with others based on your accomplishments. You drive awareness about the impact and consequences of technical decisions on the business.
5. You relentlessly simplify. You demonstrate significant innovation, creativity, and judgement when solving challenging problems.
6. You identify future skills needed across your organization and advocate for the development and/or acquisition of those skills to senior leaders. You scout top talent and recruit them to Amazon.
7. You actively mentor senior and Principal engineers. You develop and institutionalize best practices
 Basic qualifications: • 10+ years of professional software development experience
• 8+ years of programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, C++
• 8+ years contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
 Preferred qualifications: • Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field
• 2+ years hands-on experience as a senior Principal Engineer leading multiple software engineering 
• Experience shipping successful large-scale supply chain projects
• Experience partnering with Research Science or Machine Learning experts to drive optimizations using the latest techniques.

title: Applied Scientist II, Alexa Ads
desc:
Alexa+ is the world’s best Generative AI powered personal assistant / agent for consumers, and is becoming the conversational AI interface for Amazon services with the launch of Alexa for Shopping on Amazon.com and Amazon mobile app. At Alexa Ads, we are creating industry's first and most advanced Agentic Advertising products to drive Agentic Commerce. title: Warehouse Automation Manager, Engineering
desc:
Are you passionate about designing automation solutions that improve how millions of packages move through a fulfillment network? Amazon is looking for a Warehouse Automation Manager to drive innovation and product development for material handling equipment (MHE) across our operations. In this role, you will own the automation roadmap — from early-stage concept engineering and prototype design through vendor development and full-scale rollout. You will research emerging technologies, evaluate cost-effective alternatives, and collaborate with Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance teams to deliver solutions that increase productivity and capacity. If you thrive on turning ideas into real-world systems that operate at scale, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and standardize automation prototypes for conveyors, lifts, and other MHE, managing the full lifecycle from concept engineering through implementation and performance qualification.
- Build and own the automation roadmap by researching new technologies, benchmarking industry best practices, and evaluating alternative solutions that balance quality, cost, and operational impact.
- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders — including Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance — to develop material flow layouts and engineering specifications for new and existing facilities.
- Lead vendor qualification, development, and management activities including preparation of Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), and scopes of work, while driving techno-commercial discussions with procurement and project teams.
- Leverage generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and data-driven analysis to identify process improvements, optimize designs, and accelerate solution development cycles.
A day in the life
You will start your week reviewing progress in business review forums, aligning priorities against the automation roadmap, and adjusting plans based on operational feedback. Much of your time is spent independently — prototyping concepts, analyzing power requirements, and refining engineering specifications — then shifting into collaborative sessions with partner teams to pressure-test designs and resolve technical trade-offs. You will stay connected to the professional community and market trends, bringing fresh ideas back to the team to keep solutions affordable and forward-looking.
About the team
Our team is on a mission to strengthen Amazon's automation charter by creating innovative MHE solutions that scale operations across fulfillment buildings. We work at the intersection of mechanical engineering, controls, and product development, turning ideas into systems that move real packages every day. Senior leaders provide strategic vision while team members take ownership of execution, building expertise through self-directed learning and engagement with the broader engineering community. This is a team where your work directly translates into measurable productivity and capacity gains. Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree
- Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
- Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process Preferred qualifications: - Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- Experience in preventative maintenance systems
