Amazon's Devices & Services Trust CX Innovations team is building the future of responsible AI for consumer devices. We deliver privacy-first, accessible, and trustworthy AI experiences that millions of customers use daily across Amazon's device ecosystem—including Alexa, Echo, and other ambient computing products. Our mission is to ensure that as we push the boundaries of generative AI innovation, we maintain Amazon's high bar for customer trust, privacy, inclusion, and accessibility.

title: Applied Scientist II, Cross Border Science and Analytics
desc:
The Cross-Border (XB) Science & Analytics team is at the heart of Amazon's international marketplace expansion, powering science-driven solutions that enable customers across 20+ countries to discover and purchase products seamlessly across borders. Our work directly impacts millions in annualized business value through ML models, algorithms, and data-driven systems that solve some of Amazon's most complex cross-border challenges.
We are a lean, high-impact team of scientists working across various programs spanning search ranking, demand forecasting, pricing optimization, product recommendations, language understanding, and generative AI. We partner closely with product, engineering, and business teams across Amazon's global retail organization to take science from ideation to production at scale.
Key job responsibilities
We are looking for a passionate and technically strong Applied Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and algorithms that directly improve the cross-border shopping experience for millions of Amazon customers worldwide. You will work on challenging, ambiguous problems—from improving search relevance across languages to building ML-powered pricing and recommendation systems—with significant autonomy and end-to-end ownership.
This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will publish your research internally and externally, collaborate with world-class scientists and engineers, and see your work go live across Amazon's global marketplaces. 
A day in the life
Research & Experimentation
Analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, formulate hypotheses, and design experiments
Develop and iterate on ML models (deep learning, NLP, ranking, causal inference) to improve cross-border product discovery, relevance, and conversion
Design and run A/B experiments on live traffic to measure model impact against business and customer metrics
Building & Shipping
Write production-quality code (Python, Java/Scala) and work with SDEs to deploy models into real-time and batch inference pipelines
Build end-to-end ML pipelines—from data ingestion and feature engineering to training, evaluation, and online serving
Own model monitoring, performance debugging, and iterative improvements post-launch
Collaboration & Communication
Participate in weekly science syncs, design reviews, and cross-functional standups with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders
Translate business problems into well-defined science problems, and communicate results and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences
Contribute to technical documentation—architecture wikis, experiment write-ups, and model cards
Growth & Community
Present at internal ML paper reading sessions and science forums
Stay current with state-of-the-art research (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, KDD) and bring new ideas to the team
Mentor junior scientists and interns; participate in hiring interviews and debriefs
Publish findings in top-tier venues and file patents where applicable

title: Product Manager-II, Amazon SEND
desc:
We are seeking a Product Manager to help scale Amazon SEND, a cross border logistics solution for WW FBA sellers. You will work backwards from customer problems, translate insights into clear product requirements, and partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to bring your vision to life. This role puts you at the center of product decisions where your analytical thinking, technical curiosity, and ability to drive alignment across teams will directly influence the product experience that global sellers are using every day. This role requires strong product judgment, analytical capability, stakeholder management, and the ability to drive progress across teams. As a Product Manager, you will build capabilities to improve value proposition on Amazon SEND, with end to end ownership. If you are a collaborative, data-driven product thinker who thrives on turning ambiguity into action, we want to hear from you.
Key job responsibilities
- Define product requirements and roadmap priorities by working backwards from customer needs, making smart trade-offs across engineering, design, and stakeholder teams to deliver the right capabilities at the right time.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, finance, marketing, and operations partners, building alignment and influencing teams with different priorities to move products forward.
- Leverage data and customer research to inform product decisions — analyze usage patterns, customer behavior, and feedback to distinguish between what customers say they want and what they actually need.
- Own clear and concise product documentation including specifications and PR/FAQs, and communicate product strategy effectively to partners and leadership.
- Evaluate opportunities to integrate generative AI tools and emerging technologies into product workflows, refining outputs and applying responsible practices to accelerate development and improve customer outcomes.

Amazon SEND is a seller central integrated cross border logistics solution that enables global FBA sellers to ship their inventory from origin country to Amazon FCs in the destination country. title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
desc:
Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross-functional environment.
Key job responsibilities
• Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
• As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
• Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
• Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
• Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.
 Basic qualifications: • Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
• 15+ years of software engineering experience.
• 8+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
• Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
• Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
• Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
• Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.
 Preferred qualifications: • Master's degree in computer science or related field.
• Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user-facing technologies.
• Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
• Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production-ready solutions.
• Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• AI Leadership Competencies -We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
o AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
o AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost-per-interaction, trust).
o Driving AI-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
o Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
desc:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. 
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.
Key job responsibilities
· Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform 
· Architect AI-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
· In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy 
· Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud 
· Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS 
· Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community 
· Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers 
· Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates 
· Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support
A day in the life
· Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
· Develop proof-of-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
· Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
· Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
· Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures
About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
 Basic qualifications: - 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field Preferred qualifications: - Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

title: Applied Scientist, Traffic Quality
desc:
Amazon Ads is a multi-billion dollar global business that delivers advertising experiences across Amazon's owned-and-operated properties (including Prime Video, Twitch, Fire TV, and Amazon.com), third-party publisher networks, and emerging channels like generative AI-powered shopping experiences. As one of the fastest-growing segments of Amazon, we operate at unprecedented scale across desktop, mobile, connected TV, and emerging surfaces.
Within Amazon Ads, Traffic Quality is a critical pillar of advertiser trust and marketplace integrity. Our mission is to build advanced capabilities that work at petabyte scale to detect sophisticated invalid traffic (IVT) which includes sophisticated non-human traffic, bot networks, and fraudulent engagement patterns across programmatic advertising. We are on a journey to establish Amazon Ads as an industry leader in traffic quality standards and transparency. Our research agenda focuses on staying ahead of adversarial actors through continuous innovation in detection methodologies, leveraging state-of-the-art techniques in deep learning and generative modeling, user behavior and multi-modal representation learning, anomaly detection, time-series analysis, and sparse labeling methods. We process billions of ad events daily, developing novel algorithms that balance precision and recall while operating under strict latency constraints. Our work directly protects hundreds of millions of dollars in advertiser spend annually while maintaining a seamless user experience.
Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist II in Traffic Quality, you will solve inherently hard problems in advertising fraud detection using deep learning, self-supervised techniques, representation learning, and advanced clustering. You'll work on systems that process billions of ad impressions and clicks per day, using Amazon's cloud services including EC2, S3, EMR, Sagemaker, and RedShift.
- Define and frame new research problems in fraud detection where neither problem nor solution is well-defined.
- Invent and adapt new machine learning approaches, models, and algorithms to detect sophisticated invalid traffic.
- Design and deploy production-quality ML components that directly impact advertiser trust and the business top-line.
- Apply domain knowledge to perform broad data analysis as a precursor to modeling and build business insights.
- Work with unstructured and massive datasets to deliver results.
- Produce research reports meeting top-tier external publication standards.
- Contribute to the scientific community through publications at peer-reviewed venues and reviewing research submissions.
- Mentor and develop junior scientists on the team.
About the team
Here are a few papers published by the team:
1/ [Scaling Generative Pre-training for User Ad Activity Sequences. AdKDD 2023.](https://assets.amazon.science/b7/42/03be071743d5a57cb1656e6caa34/scaling-generative-pre-training-for-user-ad-activity-sequences.pdf)
2/ [SLIDR: Real-time Robot Detection On Online Ads, IAAI 2023, Deployed Highly Innovative Applications of AI Track (AAAI 2023)](https://assets.amazon.science/75/2f/3b7106b143f38f7f4d2806388ace/real-time-detection-of-robotic-traffic-in-online-advertising.pdf)
3/ [Self-supervised Representation Learning Across Sequential and Tabular Features Using Transformers, NeurIPS 2022, First Table Representation Learning Workshop](https://openreview.net/forum?id=wIIJlmr1Dsk) Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing Preferred qualifications: - 2+ years of hands-on predictive modeling and large data analysis experience
- 2+ years of designing experiments and statistical analysis of results experience

desc:
Job Description:
Are you interested in being part of rapidly expanding Amazon initiative to redefine how we deliver packages to Amazon customers and take your skills and career to the next level? Join the Last Mile Data Engineering Team (LMDET) to raise the bar for our delivery channels and redefines Amazon’s global Last Mile delivery network. 
Key job responsibilities
Last Mile Data Engineering Team is looking for a Data Engineer (DE) to play a significant role in building their large-scale, high-volume, high-performance data integration and delivery services. These data solutions would be primarily used in periodic reporting, and drive business decision making while dealing efficiently with the massive scale of data available through our Data Warehouse as well as our software systems. You will be responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, evaluating, deploying, and documenting data warehouse/data lake solutions, enabling stakeholders to manage the business and make effective decisions. You are expected to build efficient, flexible, extensible, and scalable data models, ETL designs and data integration services. You are required to support and manage growth of these data solutions. You must be a self-starter and be able to learn on the go. Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required as you will work very closely with diverse teams. As a Data Engineer, you will be working in one of the largest cloud-based data lakes. You should be skilled in the architecture of data warehouse solutions for the Enterprise using multiple platforms (EMR, RDBMS, Columnar, Cloud). You should have extensive experience in the design, creation, management, and business use of extremely large datasets. You should have excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions. Above all you should be passionate about working with huge data sets and someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions and drive change.
About the team
The Last Mile Data Engineering Team (LMDET) is a specialized data engineering organization focused on delivering seamless, secure, and governed access to Last Mile datasets at scale. The team designs and owns large-scale data lake and data warehouse infrastructures, including the Last Mile Data Repository (LMDR) and Campus data platforms, housing 10,000+ datasets across domains such as maps, geocoding, routing, and transportation. Leveraging AWS and industry-leading big data technologies, the team builds complex ETL pipelines, near-real-time data ingestion systems, and reusable datasets that power analytics, business reviews, and machine learning model development. LMDET also drives innovation through Generative AI-powered solutions for natural language querying, auto-insight generation, geocoding orchestration, and unified workflow automation, partnering closely with business, science, product, and technology teams to enable intelligent, data-driven decision-making across the Last Mile organization. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of data engineering experience
- 4+ years of SQL experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- 2+ years of developing and operating large-scale data structures for business intelligence analytics using ETL/ELT processes experience
- Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS Preferred qualifications: - Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
desc:
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Business Intelligence Engineer III, RISC - Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
desc:
Are you passionate about transforming complex data challenges into scalable analytics solutions that drive business strategy at Amazon scale? If so, we'd like to talk to you.
As a Business Intelligence Engineer on the WW EPR team, you will own the design, build, and scaling of data infrastructure and BI solutions that power our Worldwide EPR compliance and circularity programs. You will tackle complex, ambiguous problems with high autonomy — building data solutions that inform cross-functional decisions across multiple teams and regions. You will define the team's BI architecture strategy, leverage emerging technologies including Generative AI, and drive innovation in regulatory intelligence, reporting, and cost optimization across global markets.
Key job responsibilities
Data Architecture & BI Solutions
• Lead design and delivery of BI solutions spanning EPR compliance, recycling fee analytics, regulatory tracking, and circular economy metrics across worldwide jurisdictions (NA, EU, APAC, emerging markets)
• Define the team's BI architecture strategy — ensuring pipelines, models, and reporting are scalable, extensible, and aligned with organizational standards
• Architect end-to-end solutions: ETL/ELT pipelines, dimensional models, and self-service analytics enabling real-time decision support across geographies
• Harmonize multi-jurisdictional regulatory data — normalizing diverse reporting requirements, fee structures, and compliance timelines across global EPR regimes
• Proactively resolve architecture deficiencies; drive simplification and cross-team integration
Advanced Analytics & Decision Support
• Build automated frameworks that surface cost-saving opportunities within EPR fee structures, eco-modulation incentives, and take-back economics globally
• Integrate EPR cost signals into upstream business decisions — enabling retail and Selling Partner teams to assess cost impact during product selection, design, and pricing
• Develop statistical models and KPI calibration (anomaly detection, regression, confidence intervals) to monitor compliance health and fee trends across WW programs
• Deliver executive-facing narratives, MBR/QBR inputs, and data-driven recommendations for senior leadership
Generative AI & Automation
• Leverage GenAI and LLMs to enhance regulatory data extraction, classification, and reporting workflows
• Design AI-augmented solutions (automated regulatory change detection, intelligent fee categorization, natural language querying of compliance datasets)
• Evaluate and implement AI/ML technologies to improve data quality, accelerate insights, and reduce manual overhead
Technical Leadership & Mentorship
• Set engineering standards, drive code quality, conduct design reviews, and establish operational excellence best practices for the EPR BI function
• Mentor BIE I/II team members; provide technical assessments for promotions and hiring loops
• Influence cross-functional technical decisions by driving BI best practices across partner teams
• Lead the hiring bar for BI roles — recruit, design interview loops, and assess candidates
About the team
Our Worldwide EPR team owns Amazon's global compliance strategy for Extended Producer Responsibility — ensuring adherence to post-consumer waste regulations across packaging, electronics, batteries, and textiles in all operating regions. We enable circular economy value for Selling Partners, Vendors, and customers by connecting every product sold to verified recovery outcomes with auditable results. We work cross-functionally with Legal, Business, Product, and Data Science/Engineering teams across NA, EU, APAC, and emerging markets to deliver compliance programs at scale.
EPR shifts post-consumer waste management costs from municipalities to producers — requiring all Selling Partners on Amazon's marketplace to register, report product data, pay recycling fees to PROs, and establish take-back systems. This incentivizes environmentally friendly product and packaging design.
EPR is part of the Regulatory Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, dedicated to protecting Amazon customers from products that are illegal, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited Basic qualifications: - 10+ years of professional or military experience
- 5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.

- Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling

- Experience using Cloud Storage and Computing technologies such as AWS Redshift, S3, Hadoop, etc.

title: Creative Manager, Elevated Shopping (éshop)
desc:
Elevated Shopping enhances the shopping experience through video, LED production, photography,
graphic design, and usability design. With a global network of Creative Hubs in North America, Europe,
and Asia, Elevated Shopping focuses on video and CGI production, LED production, fashion and
product photography, photo retouching, graphic design, automated image acquisition, and image
support services. We continuously innovate and set new industry standards for showcasing millions of
products across multiple global marketplaces.
We are searching for a Creative Manager who will report to the Sr Studio Manager and lead
end-to-end creative production for Amazon’s India (Gurugram) Creative Hub. This is a people manager role:
the successful candidate will directly manage a team of Art Directors, Videographers, and creative
professionals, owning their development, performance, and day-to-day direction. The Creative
Manager will oversee project management, coordinate with Producers on production schedules and budgets, and other stakeholders (who are cross-functional partners, not direct reports), and drive
creative excellence across video, LED production, photography, and motion content. This person must
also have a strong understanding of generative AI tools and their application in creative workflows, as
well as LED production technologies.
Key job responsibilities
• Manage end-to-end creative production for multiple brands and campaigns simultaneously, from
concept through delivery
• Define creative needs and provide creative expertise to internal stakeholders and external clients
• Recommend effective production approaches and launch strategies based on past performance,
client goals, and studio capabilities
• Directly manage a team of Art Directors, Videographers, and creative professionals; partner with
Producers, Digitechs, Stylists, Editors, and 3D Artists as cross-functional stakeholders to ensure
seamless execution
• Drive timely decisions, clear blockers, and escalate appropriately to accelerate campaign
progress
• Manage project timelines, budgets, and resource allocation across concurrent productions
• Provide creative recommendations and insights that inform production decisions and drive
increased performance
• Ensure all creative output meets quality standards and brand guidelines
• Optimize campaign workflows and team processes; recommend improvements to cross-team and
partner processes
• Manage relationships with external vendors, agencies, and production partners
• Own people management responsibilities for direct reports including performance reviews, career
development, coaching, and hiring; foster a high-performing team culture
A day in the life
You’ll start your day reviewing production schedules and connecting with your direct reports (Art
Directors, Stylist, Videographers) on priorities and blockers. You might join a creative kick-off for a new
video campaign, then pivot to reviewing shot lists and storyboards for an ongoing shoot. You’ll
coordinate with Producers on timelines and resource needs as key stakeholders. In the afternoon, you
could be on set overseeing a video production, ensuring all content is captured on schedule, or in a
post-production review providing feedback on edits and color correction. You’ll close the day by
updating stakeholders on progress, conducting a 1:1 with a team member, and planning for the next
production milestone.
About the team
Our Creative Hub team is a dynamic group of creative professionals spanning video production,
photography, styling, LED production, and post-production. We produce high-volume, high-quality
visual content for global brands across fashion, beauty, lifestyle, and consumer electronics. We pride
ourselves on operational excellence, creative innovation, and a collaborative culture that empowers every team member to deliver their best work. Basic qualifications: - Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- 3+ years of budgeting, scheduling and technical workflows experience
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Experience working on or with large-scale, global creative campaigns

title: Software Development Engineer, SW-Device OS
desc:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, Lab126 has produced devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV, Amazon Echo, and Dash Button.
The Device OS team is central to creating these innovative devices, providing the core OS, platform, features, and components. We are inventing the future of consumer electronics and are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help bring that vision to life — solving real-world challenges that transform our customers' experiences. The team builds scalable solutions that enable our partners to quickly and cost-effectively develop and launch new device experiences.
If you love being hands-on designing and implementing high-quality platforms for consumer electronic devices while working alongside a world-class, highly accomplished team, we'd love to talk with you.
Key job responsibilities
Engage in the design and development of core OS, platform, and embedded software components, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
Partner closely with Product Management to detail and disambiguate requirements.
Design, implement, and ship high-quality embedded software for a wide range of Amazon Devices, from concept through launch.
Own the quality of your own work — both code and design — and help junior team members meet or exceed the quality bar.
Diagnose and resolve complex issues across the stack in resource-constrained environments.
A day in the life
In our team, you will get to build products and features from the ground up. You will define and build features and tools used by thousands of developers for building for millions of customers. We work across multiple internal teams as well as product to define what we are building and make it a reality. SDEs on this team are actively writing code, as well as working on designs and mentoring others. As the Device OS org we get to work horizontally across many exciting new device types. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

title: Account Manager, FSI-Fintech, Account Manager, FSI-Fintech
desc:
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider? Amazon Web Services India Pvt Ltd is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for world-class candidates to join our–FSI Fintech business.
As a Fintech Account Leader for AWS India, your responsibilities will include building and driving the strategy to increase adoption, and market penetration in large Fintech accounts to build long-term business and marketing opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess a business development/sales background that enables them to engage at all levels of a customer and partner organization, including C-levels of the business and Tech. You should be a self-starter who is prepared to develop and execute against a coverage plan business objectives. This is a high visibility role needing to engage CXOs of Fintechs as well as leverage internal executives to drive transformational outcomes for large Fintechs in the long term.
Key job responsibilities
• Develop long-term strategic relationships with the C-levels of Business & Tech for the given Accounts.
• Work closely with the Channels team to ensure that AWS India is the partner's preferred cloud computing platform across all service lines.
• Maintain an accurate forecast and various business reports.
• Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS Cloud Offerings and AI offerings
• Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, GenAI and Agentic AI, Infrastructure solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) & Internet architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc)
• Prepare and give business reviews to the senior management team.
• Ensure customer satisfaction
A day in the life
Research on the FSI Fintech domain and preparation for the day’s customers meetings and calls. Collaborate with Cross functional teams on pitches and solution demos for,
Customer meeting(s) and customer cadence calls
Stakeholder mapping
Ensure high standards and maintain SFDC hygiene
Ensure timely communication with External and Internal stakeholders
About the team
This team is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from enterprise-level FSI customers. The team interacts with leading FSI and Fintech companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. - Bachelor's degree or above
- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software) Preferred qualifications: - 10+ years of positioning cloud technology to CXOs in assigned region experience

title: Tax Analyst - CapEx, US CapEx Team
desc:
Amazon is seeking a Tax Analyst to join its Direct Tax Reporting team in Hyderabad, India. This role supports the Worldwide CapEx team with the reporting of US income tax consequences for Amazon’s unparalleled portfolio of assets. Areas of focus include operating and finance leases, depreciation of fixed assets, amortization of intangibles, and cost recovery of digital content.
A successful candidate will have excellent organizational and communication skills, great attention to detail, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a deadline-driven, dynamic environment. Experience with technology tools to automate the organization of vast amounts of data into useful information is essential.
Responsibilities
- Assist in preparation of Amazon’s US income tax provision, forecast, and tax returns as it relates to CapEx transactions by analyzing US GAAP reporting, determining book-tax differences, preparing workpapers and technical memorandums, and performing tax law research 
- Assist in preparation of deferred tax reconciliations for CapEx assets; identify drivers of basis differences
- Identify and assist in implementing process improvements which increase efficiency, scalability, and accuracy of data
- Assist in build and implementation of analysis and metrics reports to be communicated to tax management, finance partners, and external auditors 
- Assist in coordinating information requests with business partners and external service providers to ensure accurate and timely inclusion within various tax reporting deliverables
- Participate in special projects as assigned
Basic Qualifications

title: FGBS ACES Sr CI Expert, FGBS ACES
desc:
At Amazon we strive to be Earth’s most customer obsessed company. Our passion for invention leads us to continually pioneer and globalize new businesses and customer offerings. As a result, Amazon continues to grow and evolve across many different business lines. 
In supporting this growth and evolution, Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) goal is to deliver seamless procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and payroll processes that enable geographic and market expansion across all Amazon’s businesses, from Retail, Digital, and Advertising through to AWS and Logistics, while ensuring regulatory and legal compliance. As part of this growth, we now seek a Customer Obsessed, Results Driven Sr Business Development Expert for our Amazon Customer Excellence Services (ACES) team within Finance Global Business Services (FGBS). 
The ACES Business Development team is a project discovery task force that specializes in linking business strategy to opportunity identification and project selection. We believe the future of successful project management involves doing the right projects — not just doing projects right. That means making excellent decisions about which opportunities should become projects. The business development strategy uses a combination of voice of the customer, voice of the business, voice of the employee, and voice of the process to capture improvement opportunities in complex interdependent business functions. 
This role leads the identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts. You will apply a mixture of qualitative, quantitative, networking, and leadership skills to drive a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement. The program strategy is defined, but the business problem and solution may not be. You deliver independently, seeking direction on strategic priorities. 
You will leverage AI as a force multiplier across the entire business development lifecycle — from AI-powered data mining and predictive opportunity identification, to automated process analysis and intelligent stakeholder engagement. You do not simply use AI; you deliver business development differently because of it. 
Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities will span the following core dimensions: 
Strategic Opportunity Identification & AI-Augmented Discovery 
Lead project discovery and define phases of high-impact Lean Six Sigma projects (DMAIC, DFSS, Kaizen, FMEA, etc.), partnering with FGBS business teams to identify opportunities related to cost saving, revenue leakage, and efficiencies. 
Leverage AI tools to accelerate and enhance opportunity identification — using AI-powered data mining, predictive analytics, and automated process analysis to identify patterns and opportunities that manual analysis would miss. 
Manage a portfolio of improvement projects, including auditing of transitioned projects to ensure that process improvements are sustained and benefits are realized. 
Develop quantitative and qualitative process maps to describe how various people and teams within a business are involved in a process, objectively evaluating process workflows to understand the current state. 
Discover and assess automation initiatives, regulatory compliance opportunities, and other critical business decisions. 
Cross-Organizational Partnerships & Influence 
Develop cross-organizational partnerships to drive identification, quantification, and definition of project opportunities between FGBS verticals and FGBS ACES Black Belts. 
Work closely with FGBS and corporate partners (Finance, Accounting, Legal, HR, Facilities, Safety, IT, Customer Service) to secure support and resources for savings opportunities. 
Represent FGBS ACES in local and global meetings/conference calls and with network-wide projects. 
Influence customers, roadmap priorities, and decisions across multiple teams. 
Data Analytics & Quantification 
Conduct advanced data mining to conclude if defects will lead to excessive costs, reduced revenue/GMS, or increased audit/controllership risks. 
Read and transform organizational data to evaluate process details, prioritize fixes, and continually track workflows. 
Leverage AI to automate data extraction, pattern recognition, and predictive modelling for opportunity assessment. 
Provide periodic updates to senior management, including opportunity pipeline metrics, impact projections, and strategic recommendations for project selection. 
Training & Development 
Mentor team members on business development methodology, data analytics, and AI-augmented discovery approaches. 
Coach new team members on Lean, Six Sigma, and project management fundamentals. 
Promote a culture of exploration, opportunity creation, and continuous improvement. 
Share business development best practices and AI-augmented approaches across the ACES community. 
Communication & Influence 
Contribute to team and organization documents (e.g., opportunity assessments, project charters, MBR/QBR, roadmaps). 
Translate complex data sets into actionable strategies and compelling narratives for stakeholders. 
Influence managers and peer teams without authority, driving alignment on project selection and prioritization. 
 Communicate effectively across an increasing diversity of business and technical audiences. 
A day in the life
 Lead project discovery activities — using AI-powered data mining and process analysis to identify high-value improvement opportunities. 
 Partner with FGBS business teams and ACES Black Belts to quantify and define project opportunities. 
 Manage the opportunity portfolio — auditing transitioned projects and tracking sustained benefits. 
 Develop comprehensive process maps and conduct advanced current-state analysis across value streams. 
 Mentor L4 team members on business development methodology and AI-augmented approaches. 
 Represent FGBS ACES in cross-functional forums and drive alignment on project selection.

title: Business Analyst Support, AOP Research Science
desc:
The candidate would be responsible for creating/maintaining complex SQL queries and scheduling/refreshing ETL jobs. They would be required to automate manual tasks and simplify them using Python. They would also be required to build data pipelines/dashboards, take up dive deep requests, make changes to existing analytical framework and provide data support to concerned stakeholders. The person should have a good understanding of a business requirement and the ability to quickly get to the root cause of a particular reporting/BI/data issue and draft solutions for resolution specially during high demand period like OP/3YF planning. The ideal candidate would be high on attention detail, show bias for action and keen interest in analytics/BI/automation. 
Some of the key result areas include, but not limited to:
Own the design, development and maintenance of ongoing data pipelines, queries, metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to drive key business decisions. Ensure data accuracy by validating data for new and resources.
Work closely with stakeholders (internal/external) to understand and automate/enhance the existing processes.
Should be open to learn and develop skillsets in the latest data and AWS technologies and analytical techniques
Should be able to solve a business problem through a solution driven by data.
Should be able to come up with innovative ideas for new work or to improve existing work.
Key job responsibilities
- Monitor the health of the team's production models and pipelines, and run recurring executions on schedule (e.g., periodic model runs, data refreshes, reporting cadences).
- Perform first-level troubleshooting of pipeline and model-run failures — diagnosing common issues (data quality, missing inputs, job failures) and resolving them with minimal guidance, escalating deeper modeling issues to the OR scientists with clear, well-documented context.
- Maintain run documentation, runbooks, and operational trackers so execution is consistent and repeatable.
- Validate inputs and outputs for each run, flagging anomalies before they reach stakeholders.
A day in the life
You are the operational backbone that keeps our optimization models running reliably. Your day starts with health-checks on production runs — validating inputs/outputs and first-level troubleshooting of failures, resolving common issues with minimal guidance and escalating deeper modeling questions to the OR scientists. The rest of your time goes to BI work: complex SQL, Python automation, pipelines, dashboards, and dive-deep requests. You partner with Research Scientists, BIEs, and Program/Product Managers, serving supply-chain planning teams across ROW markets — with stakes peaking during OP/3YF planning cycles where accuracy and fast turnaround matter most.
About the team
The GSARC-AOP (Analytics Operations & Programs) Research Science team builds and operates decision-support and optimization products across Network Design, Quick Commerce, and Packaging for Amazon's Rest of World (ROW) marketplaces — spanning multiple OR tools. We are looking for a Business Analyst to be the operational backbone of this portfolio: keeping our production models healthy and running, and contributing hands-on analytics and BI work that supports the team's decision-making.
This is a high-ownership execution role for an analyst who is energized by reliability, likes working close to data and models, and wants to grow their technical depth alongside a team of Operations Research scientists and Business Intelligence Engineers for the multiple geographies like IN, Japan, Mexico, Brazil, MENA, AU Basic qualifications: - 2+ years of data analytics or automation experience
- Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar
- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service and experience with automation and any version control tools Preferred qualifications: - Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities and experience with automation and any version control tools
- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Master's degree, or a Bachelor's degree and experience building web based dashboards using common frameworks
- Bachelor's degree in operations, supply chain or logistics, or 2+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience

title: Signal Integrity Engineer, Amazon Devices
desc:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile devices like the Kindle family of products. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc. Since then, we have worked to produce best-selling e-readers and tablets, as well as new inventions like Echo line of products, Fire TV and Fire phone. What will you help us create?
Key job responsibilities
As a Signal Integrity Engineer, you will be part of Validation team that is exploring new hardware designs to improve our devices. In this role, you will be responsible for Signal Integrity aspects, compliance, and interoperability of package substrate, PCB, Cable solutions and system-level SI for interfaces like PCIe, DDR, Clocks etc. You will also be responsible for contributing to package and platform design guideline development.
You will work closely with multi-disciplinary groups including Board Design, System Architects, IP developers, and Design Engineering, to verify and deliver complex, high volume SoCs that enable development of world-class hardware devices. In this role, you will be:
• Responsible for defining the design guidelines for internal and external design teams and delivering reference simulation docs for customers 
• Performing modeling of package substrate/PCB channels elements in 3D/2D EM simulation tools. 
• Working with silicon designers, platform designers, package designers, electrical validation teams, etc. to support interconnect and interface performance requirements. 
• Reviewing and evaluating package and board design and providing review feedback. 
• Responsible for providing power delivery solutions across platform, package and SOC level 
• Definition of worst-case currents and voltage drop scenarios, MIM/decoupling allocation, grid choices and analysis, droop control, SOC ESD compliance, On-die droop detectors, usage of on-die delivery solutions like VR, LDO, and Power gates. Basic qualifications: - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- 4+ years of hardware design and validation of components, subsystems and systems experience
- High speed serial interface analog building blocks, protocol, specifications and test methods
- Familiarity with Simulation tools (ADS, HFSS, PowerSI, PowerDC, Hyperlynx) to execute SI-PI simulations is required.
- Experience with performing measurement, and correlating measurements to simulations.
- Experience with modeling and simulation of high-speed interface interconnects/channel.
- Excellent analytical and problem solving skills Preferred qualifications: - Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- Understanding of Power & signal integrity concepts such as differential impedance, jitter, insertion loss, return loss, termination, etc.
- Scripting experience in any programming language (C++, Python, PERL, MATLAB) to develop automation scripts is a plus.
- Experience in Analog IP Characterization (SerDes, PLL, DDR) is desirable.
- Good understanding of High-Speed Analog/Digital Circuits, VLSI, semiconductor physics

title: Software Development Engineer, Alexa Connections
desc:
Do you want to shape how people stay connected across calls, text, and email? Alexa Connections is building a trusted communication agent that understands intent, context, and relationships, then acts on a customer's behalf to make every interaction feel natural. As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you'll design and deliver the software systems behind a context-aware assistant that grows more helpful over time. You'll work across the full software development lifecycle — from understanding customer problems, through system design and implementation, to deployment and operations — building privacy-first solutions that serve tens of millions of daily communication events.
Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement software services that model each customer's personal connections graph, a privacy-first representation of relationships and communication patterns used to power context-aware assistance.
- Build and operate scalable backend systems that integrate large language models and agentic reasoning to anticipate who, when, and how a customer wants to connect across calls, text, and email.
- Collaborate with scientists, product managers, and peer engineering teams to translate research advances in personalization and memory into reliable, production-grade features.
- Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — scoping, design, code review, testing, deployment, and operational support — while coaching teammates through constructive code reviews and documentation.
- Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues, and continuously improve system reliability, maintainability, and performance.
A day in the life
Your morning might start with a design review for a new personalization feature, working through tradeoffs in scalability and data privacy with senior engineers and applied scientists. After lunch you could be writing and testing code for a service that ranks a customer's most relevant contacts, then pairing with a teammate on a code review. You'll regularly join standups with product managers and scientists to align on priorities, and you'll rotate through on-call responsibilities to keep the systems you build running smoothly.
About the team
The Alexa Connections team is growing, so you'll join early and help shape its engineering culture from the ground up. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and scientists who are invested in your growth, with mentorship and the chance to own meaningful problems. Our mission is to make communication effortless and trustworthy for customers worldwide, and we're focused on building intelligent, privacy-first systems that redefine how people stay in touch. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Brand Specialist
desc:
About Amazon
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience – Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from website to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
About the Role
Account Management- Brand Specialist
As a Brand Specialist you would be a part of Amazon Vendor Services (AVS) Team of Retail Business Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy for managing Amazon AVS vendors.
AVS team is looking for a bright, customer centric, driven, and creative candidate to join our team. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. You will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. 
You will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on operational aspects of managing the customer relationships with our vendors.
You will conceive, create and analyze a wide range of marketing activities/campaigns to grow the vendor’s traffic, brand awareness, customer conversion, and revenue on Amazon. Also, you will look into operational aspects of vendor’s business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting business. 
Timings will be as per EU shift, 12:00 pm IST to 9:00 pm IST 
Key job responsibilities
• Establish long term partnerships with key vendor partners for the group of vendors handled.
• Partnering with the Retail Category Team and build successful communication channels at all levels, set proper expectations, provide clear status communications, and manage towards a growth plan for the vendors.
• Build and execute on a joint business plan that delivers on key business opportunities and relevant KPIs for the vendors and Amazon.
• Conduct deep dive analysis on vendor issues and publish recommendations and action plans based on data to improve vendor experience.
• Success will be measured by the performance of your vendors on input metrics and impact on creating a great customer experience for buying consumers.
• Conduct regular WBRs, MBRs with the vendors, highlight business metric performance and building action plans. Basic qualifications: - Experience with Excel
- 1+ years of Account Management/Vendor Management Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of Account Management/Vendor Management

title: Applied Scientist II, Amazon Business - External Integrations
desc:
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Master's degree, or PhD Preferred qualifications: - Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

desc:
The Amazon Delivery and Shopping Experience Product Team is looking for a Data Engineer-III who will develop data solutions to optimize customer experience by disproportionately improving discoverability and speed. As part of Amazon’s DEX product team, you have the opportunity to be at the forefront of DEX product thought leadership - working on some of the most difficult Customer Experience problems while partnering with research scientists, software developers, and business leaders. With the focus on driving real impact on Amazon's long-term profitability, we build new data sets & analysis from ground up, proposing new concepts and technology to meet business needs. We need a strong Data Engineer who enjoys and excels at diving into data, analyzing root causes, defining long-term solutions and driving their implementation with stakeholders.
This position requires someone who can quickly approach large ambiguous problems and apply their technical and engineering expertise to rapidly prototype and deliver solutions. This role also requires you to work across a variety of teams, including software tech teams, operations, finance, category, search, and inventory platform (software) teams. Successful candidates must thrive in fast-paced environments which encourage collaborative and creative problem solving.
An ideal candidate will be someone with sound technical background in managing large data infrastructures, working with petabyte-scale data, building scalable data solutions/automations and driving operational excellence. An ideal candidate will be someone who is a self-starter that can start with a Platform requirement & work backwards to conceive and devise best possible solution, a good communicator while driving customer interactions, a passionate learner of new technology when the need arises, a strong owner of every deliverable in the team, obsessed with customer delight, business impact and ‘gets work done’ in business time.

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Amazon Business - External Integrations
desc:
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues. Basic qualifications: - PhD, or Master's degree and 8+ years of applied research experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language Preferred qualifications: - Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
- Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
