title: Capacity Intelligence Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance
desc:
As a Capacity Intelligence Analyst within the Network Strategy & Performance team, you will support and execute labor planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data and operations — translating demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while contributing to cost efficiency.
You will operate independently within your workstream, navigating ambiguity with analytical rigor and sound judgment. You will build effective working relationships with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior stakeholders, contribute to planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and actively participate in the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.
This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and contributes directly to outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.
Key job responsibilities
- Support the development, maintenance, and execution of labor capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons. Build toward full ownership of assigned planning workstreams.
- Proactively identify and flag capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and proposed mitigation plans to stakeholders with clarity and specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, contributing to accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of your planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, and contribute concrete use cases to the team's AI adoption agenda.
- Develop structured frameworks to address recurring planning problems within your scope, reducing rework and improving the consistency of planning outputs over time.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to senior stakeholder audiences independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic stakeholders. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate planning analysis in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences, anticipating likely objections to your recommendations and addressing them proactively.
Core Competencies
- AI Fluency: Independently applies AI tools to improve planning workflows without prompting. Develops side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your own workstream. Coaches at least one peer on AI tool usage. Contributes to the team's AI adoption agenda with concrete use cases demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Critical Thinking: Independently diagnoses complex planning problems. Challenges assumptions — including your own — with data. Develops structured frameworks to address recurring problems within your scope. Anticipates the most likely objections to a recommendation and addresses them proactively.
- Executive Presence: Presents analysis and recommendations to senior audiences independently. Adapts communication style for different stakeholders — technical and non-technical, operational and strategic. Handles pushback constructively without becoming defensive or capitulating without reason.
- Problem Solving: Navigates ambiguous problems with limited guidance. Develops multiple solution options with explicit trade-off analysis. Drives problems to resolution end-to-end — does not hand off and forget. Learns from misses and applies those learnings to the next problem.
- Boundaryless: Builds effective working relationships with key partner teams — Service Delivery, CS Finance, and GO Vendor Management. Proactively identifies and resolves cross-team dependencies before they become blockers. Represents Network Strategy & Performance in partner forums with credibility.
About the team
The Network Strategy & Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.
We analyze historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.
The Network Strategy & Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an experienced Capacity Intelligence Analyst to join this team and contribute to how Amazon plans, staffs, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

title: Transportation Representative, AV
desc:
TOC (Transportation Operation Center) is the central command and control center for
‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple
geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight
from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case
of any exceptions, TOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on
the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving TOC is also charged with
understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process
changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and
significant analysis of network data.
Overall, TOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation
and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative
A Trans Ops Representative at TOC facilitates flow of information between different
stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts
customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at TOC works across two
verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is
picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on
Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck
leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on
Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC
and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and
querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to
understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive
Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic
understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral
form. Trans Ops Specialist should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the
zeal to drive them to conclusion. 
Key job responsibilities
• Act as the primary point of contact between Amazon's internal teams and North America (NA) business customers to validate and confirm accurate address and location details.
• Apply a strong eye for detail to research, verify, and update correct address and geo-coordinate information in Geo Studio.
• Process a high volume of Address ID's within defined time windows while consistently maintaining a quality bar of 98% or higher.
• Communicate fluently and confidently in English (verbal and written) when speaking with NA business customers to resolve address discrepancies.
• Identify patterns in flagged Address ID's (e.g., incorrect pins, missing business hours, vacant locations) and escalate data gaps to the relevant teams.
• Use internal tools (Geo Studio, SIM, Connect) to research, validate, and correct address and location data.
• Track personal productivity and quality metrics daily; consistently meet Address ID handling volume and accuracy targets.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to reduce recurring address errors and improve overall data quality.
• Provide real-time support in a 24/7 operating environment, working across rotational shifts.
 Basic qualifications: - • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
- • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; comfortable speaking directly with North America based business customers.
- • Strong attention to detail with the ability to research and validate data accurately.

title: Transportation Representative, AmazonNowCO, RoW APEX
desc:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
Providing real-time customer experience Basic qualifications: - 1)Bachelor’s degree 2)12-24 months of work experience. 3)Good communication skills - Trans Ops Representative will be facilitating flow of information between external 4)Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, vlookups) 5)Demonstrated ability to work in a team in a very dynamic environment. title: Data Center Material Associate, IT Services (Warehouse)
desc:
Amazon's IT Services (ITS) team is seeking a detail-oriented Data Center Material Associate, Warehouse (Reverse Logistics) to support the recovery, tracking, and lifecycle management of IT assets within our India operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end reverse-logistics journey for IT equipment — ensuring that devices are retrieved, verified, and processed accurately as employees transition out of the organization.
You will act as the central coordination point between internal stakeholders, logistics partners, and asset-management systems to drive timely asset returns and maintain a high IT-clearance completion rate. The position combines operational execution, data accuracy, and strong communication, working within established policies and standard operating procedures.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys structured, process-driven work with measurable outcomes. You will contribute directly to inventory accuracy, cost avoidance, and compliance goals while gaining exposure to large-scale operations, logistics coordination, and IT asset-management tooling. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable managing a steady volume of cases, following up persistently, and resolving discrepancies through collaboration. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and take pride in operational excellence, we encourage you to apply.
Key job responsibilities
- Asset recovery coordination: Manage the day-to-day queue of reverse-logistics cases, ensuring IT assets are recovered promptly and tracked through each stage of the return process.
- Stakeholder communication: Send structured notifications and reminders to relevant stakeholders, follow up on pending returns, and respond to queries in a professional, timely manner.
- Logistics partner coordination: Work with third-party logistics providers to schedule pickups, confirm shipments, and validate receipt of assets at designated locations.
- Data accuracy & tracking: Maintain accurate records of asset status, movements, and discrepancies using asset-management and tracking tools; reconcile data to ensure inventory integrity.
- Discrepancy resolution: Identify and resolve mismatches, missing items, or tagging errors by collaborating with internal teams and following defined escalation paths.
- Clearance & compliance: Support IT-clearance workflows and ensure processes adhere to organizational policies and audit requirements.
- Reporting: Prepare and share regular status updates and queue reports to provide visibility into operational performance and open items.
- Process improvement: Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to increase efficiency, reduce turnaround time, and improve the overall return experience.
- Documentation: Maintain clear, organized records to support traceability and knowledge continuity across the team.
A day in the life
On a typical day, you will review and prioritize the reverse-logistics case queue, send notifications and follow-up reminders for pending asset returns, and coordinate pickups and shipments with logistics partners. You will update asset-tracking systems with current statuses, confirm receipts, and reconcile any data discrepancies. Part of your day involves responding to stakeholder queries, escalating blocked cases through defined channels, and verifying that recovered assets are correctly logged and processed. Prepare short status updates summarizing queue health and open items. Throughout, you will apply standard operating procedures to keep cases moving and ensure accuracy, timeliness, and compliance.
About the team
You will join the **ITS Reverse Logistics team**, a group dedicated to managing the recovery and lifecycle of IT assets across Amazon's India operations. The team ensures that equipment is efficiently returned, verified, and processed as employees transition, directly supporting inventory accuracy, cost efficiency, and compliance goals. We work closely with internal IT, logistics partner and logistics partners, using modern asset-management and tracking tools to coordinate a high volume of cases at scale. The team values accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement, and offers a collaborative, process-driven environment where your contributions have a clear, measurable impact on operational performance. Basic qualifications: - Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager
- 1+ years of shipping & receiving, inventory and warehousing practices experience
- Education qualification : Graduate Preferred qualifications: - Experience in courier industry, or experience in logistics

title: Data Center Material Associate, IT Services (WH)
desc:
The ITS DCMA (WH) is the primary floor operations owner for the HYD24 IT Hub warehouse. They will be responsible for end-to-end execution of warehouse workflows — from receiving/intake through imaging, wiping, inventory management, pick/pack/ship, outbound logistics, and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD). Key job responsibilities
• Execute daily production plans covering Receiving/Intake, Inventory Storage, Imaging, Wiping, Refurbishment, Pick/Pack/Ship, and Outbound Shipping. Monitor throughput targets and report SLA adherence using ServiceNow and T-SIM.

Executing daily production plans across receiving, imaging, wiping, inventory management, pick/pack/ship, and outbound shipping workflows. The ITS Warehouse team at HYD24, Hyderabad, is the backbone of Amazon's IT asset lifecycle operations. title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Amazon Now
desc:
We build the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses, the platform that powers shopping journeys across marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive platform programs spanning 12+ tenants and 500+ developers as we evolve from a multi marketplace stack into a true multi business platform.
You will own the programs that turn a single business stack into versioned API contracts, a federated front end, and surface agnostic shopping capabilities that any Amazon business can configure into a journey of its own shape. Each tenant brings different needs, and your job is to sequence that work so businesses compose journeys instead of forking the platform.
This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical programs and many stakeholder coordination, who can hold a three year architectural direction while shipping quarter over quarter, and who cares that a page is ready in sub-second at Amazon volume.
Key job responsibilities
- Own cross team programs that deliver certified, versioned API contracts and a bring your own API extension path, so new businesses onboard by configuration rather than by forking the stack.
- Drive the front end federation program (shell, component registry, tenant packages, build time isolation) across feature teams shipping independently to production.
- Coordinate onboarding of new tenants and marketplaces, cutting time to launch from three months toward weeks, and track the platform effort each onboarding costs.
- Run the performance, resilience, and observability programs that keep every journey fast and tenant isolated at scale, including interaction budgets, alarm based rollback, and prevention of cross tenant incidents.
- Build the mechanisms that govern what earns a place in the shared core versus what stays a business owned extension, resolving competing tenant needs across 12+ clients.
- Manage dependencies with partner platforms and drive convergence decisions.
- Establish program rhythm across 500+ developers: roadmaps, release schedules, risk and critical path management, and quarterly checkpoints against annual targets.
- Translate a three year platform vision into sequenced, committed deliverables with clear exit criteria.
A day in the life
You start with the programs in flight across the platform, unblocking a tenant onboarding here and a contract certification there. You work with multiple senior and principal engineers on architecture tradeoffs, with product managers on which capabilities graduate into the core, and with partner teams on shared dependencies. You keep the performance and resilience bars visible, chase down a latency regression before it crosses tenants, and prep the quarterly checkpoint against annual targets. Your stakeholders span multiple leaders from fast growing businesses WW, and your customers are the Amazon teams building shopping experience using our platform.
About the team
We currently run the customer experience platform behind Amazon's quick commerce businesses. What began as one team's customer journey stack has grown into a single platform serving multiple marketplaces at roughly 700K orders a day. We are a B2B product whose customers are Amazon businesses, and our mission is to let any of them launch, experiment, and scale a shopping journey without building the stack beneath it. Multiple Amazon businesses came to us organically because the paradigm works. We are now one architectural shape away from becoming the default place a new shopping journey starts at Amazon, and this role helps get us there. Basic qualifications: - 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules Preferred qualifications: - 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience owning program strategy for a platform, set of APIs, or shared services consumed by multiple internal teams
- Experience delivering versioned API contracts, developer facing tooling, or tenant onboarding programs at scale
- Experience driving performance, resilience, or observability programs across distributed systems
- Experience developing and executing technical roadmaps across many stakeholder teams

As a Business Development Manager within Amazon Services, you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to enable broad use of Amazon Services by small/medium sellers and large enterprises in India wishing to sell globally, and play a key role in influencing product selection on global Amazon websites. The objective of this position is to deliver on-going new business growth to Amazon's suite of seller services for businesses of all sizes by recruiting third-party sellers that deliver competitive pricing and broad product selection.

Your responsibilities will include helping define key retailer segments to target, establishing seller relationships, and drive the day-to-day interactions with these companies in order to build long-term business opportunity. Operating in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment you will work autonomously taking full control and responsibility for hitting business objectives. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the cost savings of Amazon's inventory losses.

This individual will be given responsibility on their first day to own those business challenges and the autonomy to think strategically and make data driven decisions. Ideal candidates will be a high potential, strategic and analytic graduate with a PhD in ( Research, Statistics, Engineering, and Supply Chain) ready for challenging opportunities in the core of our world class operations space. - Present key learnings and vision to stakeholders and leadership.
- Integrate ML detection models via software applications

title: Transportation Representative
desc:
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.
Key job responsibilities
Trans Ops Representative should be able to ideate process improvements and should have the zeal to drive them to conclusion.
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
· Communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
· Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions to ensure they are delivered.
· Excellent communication, both verbal and written as one may be required to create a narrative outlining weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
Providing real-time customer experience by working in 24*7 operating environment.

title: Transportation Representative, AmazonNowCO, RoW APEX
desc:
Job Description for Transportation Representative – NOC
NOC Overview
NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, India and EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.
Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
Purview of a Trans Ops Representative:
A Trans Ops Representative at NOC facilitates flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impacts customer experience and business continuity. Trans Ops Specialist at NOC works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations.
Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationship, ensuring that the freight is picked-up on time and is delivered at FC as per the given appointment. Trans Ops Specialist on Inbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of pick-up to delivery.
Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationship, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC in order to delivery customer orders as per promise. Trans Ops Specialist on Outbound addresses any potential issues occurring during the lifecycle of freight leaving the FC and reaching customer premises.
A Trans Ops Representative provides timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form. 
Key job responsibilities

desc:

Today, safety data is fragmented across seven systems with no single technical owner, causing attribution errors, reconciliation gaps, and duplicated logic. We're changing that.
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build a governed safety intelligence platform. You will contribute to three critical pillars: Safety Data as a Service (SDaaS), a governed serving layer consolidating telematics, incidents, and contextual enrichment; DSP Facing Mechanisms, a unified configuration layer managing compound signals and business rules across DSP facing surfaces; and Advanced Analytics and Agentic Capabilities, predictive models and AI agents that provide actionable safety insights.
This is a rare opportunity to join a team building a platform from the ground up that will directly impact the safety of delivery associates worldwide.
Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, and deploy software components for a governed data serving platform that consolidates telematics, incident reports, video evidence, and contextual enrichment from multiple upstream systems 
• Build and maintain backend services and APIs that support a unified configuration layer where safety business rules are authored, validated, versioned, and distributed 
• Develop frontend components for a consolidated safety dashboard, a single view where signals, scorecard outcomes, alerts, event video, and interventions come together 
• Implement compound safety signals that combine individual data sources into higher order, actionable safety indicators • Write clean, maintainable, and well tested code following software engineering best practices 
• Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence activities 
• Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to integrate data pipelines and model outputs into production services 
• Contribute to automated evidence preservation mechanisms to address short video retention windows 
• Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, participating in on call rotations to ensure system reliability 
• Work with cross functional teams including product managers, stakeholders across investigations, claims, insurance, and accountability to understand requirements and deliver solutions
A day in the life
You will be part of a team building the safety intelligence backbone for Amazon's DSP ecosystem. Your day may involve writing and reviewing code for backend services, building frontend features for the safety dashboard, discussing design approaches with your team, or debugging a production issue. You will collaborate closely with data engineers and data scientists to bring data driven capabilities to life. You'll participate in sprint planning, stand ups, and retrospectives, contributing ideas to improve both the product and the development process. You will have the opportunity to learn and grow across the full stack, from data pipelines to user facing experiences, while working on a platform that scales across multiple countries.
About the team
DSP Safety Tech is a newly established team with a clear mission: convert every safety event into a clear, trusted action for every DSP, in every market, every time. Our North Star is ensuring every safety signal reaches the people who can act on it, with the context needed to make timely decisions, so risks are identified earlier, decisions are made consistently, and every Delivery Associate goes home safely.

title: Software Development Engineer II, AFT Sortation, AFT Mansort
desc:
Have you ever wondered how Amazon delivers millions of customer orders with exceptional speed and reliability? Behind every fast and on-time delivery is a complex network of software, infrastructure, robotics, and operational processes engineered to work seamlessly at scale.
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) builds the software and infrastructure that power Amazon's world-class fulfillment centers. Our systems integrate with warehouse automation, machines, and human associates to orchestrate critical fulfillment processes across a global network. These technologies enable the movement of millions of inventory units and support billions of transactions, ensuring that customers receive the products they want, when they expect them.
About the Mansort Team
The Mansort team owns the manual sortation layer of Amazon's fulfillment network. Our systems determine where packages should be routed after packing and before reaching the outbound dock, enabling accurate and efficient movement of shipments through fulfillment centers.
We build and operate software responsible for sort plan generation, chute and destination assignment, and scan-and-sort workflows used by warehouse associates. Our systems operate on the fulfillment center floor across hundreds of buildings worldwide, where reliability, performance, and correctness directly influence operational efficiency and customer delivery promises.
Mansort operates in a technically demanding environment characterized by high transaction volumes, stringent low-latency requirements, and the need for continuous availability despite connectivity disruptions or upstream dependency failures. Correctness is equally critical: every sortation decision must accurately direct a package to its intended destination to prevent operational errors and missed transportation cutoffs.
Manual sortation complements Amazon's automated sortation capabilities by providing the flexibility and scalability needed to handle peak demand, support new geographies and fulfillment center formats, and accommodate diverse operational requirements that cannot always be addressed through fixed automation.
As Amazon continues to expand its global fulfillment network and introduce new supply chain capabilities, delivery models, and customer experiences, the Mansort team has an opportunity to solve challenging engineering problems, modernize existing systems, and build scalable, resilient solutions that support the future of fulfillment operations.
Key job responsibilities
Design and develop scalable systems by owning the architecture, design, implementation, testing, and deployment of distributed software systems operating in live fulfillment center environments.
Build high-throughput, low-latency services that meet stringent performance, scalability, and availability requirements.
Ensure operational reliability and correctness through robust sortation workflows, data integrity, routing accuracy, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation.
Solve complex business and technical problems using pragmatic engineering decisions, innovative solutions, and modern technologies.
Drive operational excellence by improving observability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and recovery mechanisms to minimize disruptions.
Collaborate with product managers, operations teams, process engineers, and partner engineering teams to improve fulfillment efficiency and customer experience.
Influence technical direction by contributing to architecture, engineering standards, and technical strategy within the team and broader organization.
Maintain high engineering standards by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code and ensuring software quality, performance, security, and reliability.

title: Software Development Engineer, Finance Technology
desc:
We are responsible for billions of dollars of payments each month to millions of Amazon vendors across the globe. We delight our vendors by paying them when they want and how they want, accurately and on time.
We build software applications that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually, rivaling the complexity and scope of dedicated payments fintech companies. Our systems decide how and when a payment happens, carry it out across the world's payment networks, and account for it — all under real regulatory, tax, and audit obligations, in every geography Amazon operates in.
You will have the opportunity to work in a high-paced environment leveraging the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) within our core principles of engineering, to deliver faster and ship features incrementally.
Ownership is the center of this role, and ownership here means the whole lifecycle rather than just the code. You will take features from working backwards from the customer through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and documentation — and you stay accountable for how they behave in production long after they ship.
Own features and components of our payment systems end-to-end. The business problem and the technology direction will be understood; how to actually build it will not be, and that part is yours.
Design the solution and make the tradeoffs. You will code independently, and you will have senior and principal engineers to pull in when a tradeoff is genuinely hard or when a design needs to line up with where the architecture is heading.
Work directly with product managers and business stakeholders — finance, tax, and accounts payable operations — to understand what they need and why, so that you build the right thing. You will hear the requirement first-hand rather than through a written hand-off, and you will be expected to push back when the ask and the outcome do not line up.
Ship incrementally. Large payment changes land safely through staged rollout and measurement, not through a single release.
Reduce operational load. Our best work turns a recurring manual intervention into a code fix or a self-healing mechanism, not another runbook step.
Leave the system better explained than you found it. What you build should be maintainable and extensible by an engineer who has never seen it, which means clear documentation and design choices that hold up without you in the room.
Raise the bar around you: code review as a teaching mechanism, mentoring engineers earlier in their careers, and getting new teammates productive on how our software is built, how it operates, and how it fits into the bigger picture.
Building with agentic AI
We are not experimenting with AI on the side — it is how we work. You will use AI agents across the development lifecycle: exploring unfamiliar systems, drafting and reviewing designs, generating and testing code, triaging production issues, and automating the operational work that used to consume a week of on-call. We expect engineers to be strong directors of these agents and rigorous verifiers of their output. The judgment stays with you: you are accountable for what ships, whether you typed it or an agent did. Agentic capabilities are increasingly part of the systems themselves — automating decisions and investigations that previously required a human in the loop — and you will have room to build them.
Why this team
Payments is one of the few places in software where the business logic is genuinely hard, the scale is enormous, and a mistake has an immediate real-world consequence — a vendor who does not get paid when they expected. If you want real ownership, global scope, and the freedom to build with the newest tools available rather than waiting for permission to try them, this is a good place to build a career. Basic qualifications: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language Preferred qualifications: - 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience debugging, profiling, and implementing best software engineering practices in large-scale systems
- Experience with cloud computing or web services or related areas
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

title: Software Development Engineer, FBA Defect Prevention
desc:
Join a new team and make a huge difference for Amazon, our sellers, and our supply chain. We are the team that deals with the exceptions to the exceptions in a complex process, saving Amazon and our sellers many millions of dollars.
The FBA Defects Prevention team within Fulfillment By Amazon is responsible for identifying and preventing defects in the FBA Supply Chain. We work across sellers, fulfilment technology, robotics and carriers to detect, root cause, gather evidence and ultimately prevent issues in the supply chain. 
As you can imagine, Amazon's inbound supply chain are incredibly complex and highly scaled. While most people marvel at the efficiency with which the inbound processes handle most shipments, we are the team that deals with the exception - when things go wrong, we're the ones engaged to root cause and identify the problems.
Examples of defects include sellers sending in the wrong item, failing to label or mislabeling packages, sending shipments to the wrong location, or failing to prep them. Detecting that these things have happened are hard - the signals coming from the network are often contradictory and misleading. We gather evidence, root cause, determine the ground truth, and then reach out to sellers to help them correct issues. 
We drive projects that save Amazon between tens and hundreds of millions of dollars through prevention and resolution of these issues, and are critical path to reducing Amazon's Cost to Serve as well as ensuring seller inbound shipments are efficiently received and available to customers.
The Defect Prevention space is complex, highly scaled, and ripe for use of new technologies. We can use Gen AI to analyze patterns, assess root causes, evaluate image data, and ultimately craft the right message to communicate with sellers on what has gone wrong. 
In addition, this is a problem area that is well suited to someone who is interested in deep diving complex issues, and then crafting solutions that effectively influence seller behavior.

 The Digital IP (DIP) group at NVIDIA is an organization of circuit design and CAD engineers that creates a wide variety of IP for the chips NVIDIA designs. One of the roles fulfilled by the DIP group is to develop sophisticated SRAM compilers that are used extensively by our SOC design partners. We are looking to hire a skilled and creative SRAM circuit designer to help achieve these goals in a high-visibility position.
 What you'll be doing: 
 Embedded SRAM design: Transistor-level circuit design, supervising layout implementation, physical and logical verification, and debug of SRAM macros.
 SRAM compiler development: Envisioning, defining, and coding more efficient ways to automate the simultaneous assembly and validation of multiple unique SRAM macros using NVIDIA's extensive compute resources.
 Advanced development: Exploring the potential of future process nodes and developing techniques to achieve optimal power, performance, and area characteristics.
 Guiding SOC design, silicon test, and productization efforts: Collaborate with SOC design partners to help them achieve their overall performance and cost goals, guide the silicon test and characterization efforts, and working with productization teams to prepare new silicon for the demanding requirements of real-world applications.
 What we need to see: 
 BSEE minimum (or equivalent experience), MSEE or PhD preferred
 3+ years of SRAM design experience with a strong background in digital circuit design, layout, and validation on advanced FinFET processes
 Prior design experience in single-port, dual-port, or register file SRAM-based macros required, including complex circuits like self-timed logic and sense-amplifiers
 Python scripting ability to parse data and automate tasks
 Successful track record of delivering designs to production
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Self-motivation, attention to detail, and good written, verbal, and presentation skills are needed to success in this role

 Silicon testing/debug experience

desc:

 Job Category 
Software Engineering 
 Job Details 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters
 Salesforce has immediate opportunities for engineers who want their work to shape how trusted enterprise AI is trained, evaluated, and delivered. You will work with a group of world-class engineers to train and post-train open-weight language models for demanding enterprise workflows.
 This is a model-training role, not a wrapper around a hosted LLM and not a prompt-engineering-only role. You will own the complete post-training loop: data generation, supervised fine-tuning, preference or reinforcement learning when appropriate, rigorous evaluation, and production serving. You will materially improve the behavior of models, not merely integrate model APIs.
 The role encompasses ML research engineering, data generation, fine-tuning, evaluation, inference systems, and technical leadership. You will own code, experiments, evaluation evidence, and production behavior. We value demonstrated engineering judgment and reproducible results over credentials, paper claims, or an extensive keyword list.
 We pride ourselves on building high-quality, maintainable systems that make the model more capable without compromising trust, safety, or operability. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while encouraging everyone to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions empower our people, products, company, and customers to thrive.
 Core Responsibilities & Scope 
 Train, adapt, and serve capable, reliable open-weight language models for enterprise workflows. 
 Own fine-tuning experiments from baseline through release: choose training objectives, run SFT and LoRA/QLoRA recipes, compare checkpoints against rigorous held-out evaluation, and diagnose failures before the next run. 
 Generate high-quality domain training data at scale, including synthetic instruction data, multi-turn conversations, reasoning and tool-use trajectories, structured outputs, counterexamples, preference pairs, and difficult evaluation cases. 
 Build the data engine behind post-training: source-grounded authoring, quality filtering, deduplication, contamination controls, dataset versioning, train/validation/test splits, packing, tokenization, and loss masking. 
 Design and run post-training experiments beyond SFT when justified, including DPO, ORPO, GRPO, RLVR, distillation, and other preference or reinforcement-learning methods. Match the method to a measured capability problem and a defensible reward signal. 
 Design and operate model-quality evaluation: held-out task suites, model-based and human review, tool-use and structured-output accuracy, multi-turn reliability, safety regressions, ablations, and error analysis. 
 Investigate model behavior deeply: identify whether a failure comes from data quality, training objective, model capacity, decoding, context handling, tool interface, or serving behavior, then produce evidence for the corrective action. 
 Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow. 
 Build reliable model-serving and inference capabilities, balancing quality, latency, throughput, memory use, and operational reliability. 
 Build robust integrations between models, tools, and enterprise systems, including structured outputs, function calling, and multi-step agent behavior. 
 Make architecture and design decisions with strong attention to model quality, reproducibility, performance, security, scalability, and future extensibility. 
 Improve observability, traceability, failure analysis, test coverage, and developer workflows across the training and serving lifecycle. 
 Work with domain experts to turn real workflows, product behavior, APIs, and failure cases into independently verifiable training and evaluation material. 
 Protect customer and company data: use approved sources only, preserve provenance, and keep credentials and sensitive data out of training and model prompts unless specifically authorized. 
 Review model, data, and application changes for factual correctness, quality, security, performance, and operational risk. 
 Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance that raises the quality bar across the team.
 Minimum Requirements 
 10+ years of software engineering experience, including technical leadership on production systems. 
 Strong Python engineering experience building and maintaining reliable production systems. 
 Hands-on ownership of LLM post-training. You have trained or materially improved open-weight language models through SFT and LoRA/QLoRA. Experience with preference optimization, RL, distillation, or continued pre-training is strongly valued. API integration alone does not qualify. 
 Hands-on ownership of training-data generation and curation. You have produced, filtered, reviewed, and versioned task-specific datasets, including synthetic instruction data, conversations, reasoning traces, tool calls, preference data, or structured outputs. 
 Strong practical understanding of the post-training stack: chat templates, tokenizer

desc:
About the Role 
 Adobe is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Adobe Genuine Engineering team. This group protects Adobe's ecosystem from fraud, abuse, and misuse using intelligent systems worldwide.
 In this position, you will build and develop machine learning models from scratch, including custom transformer-based frameworks, to identify fraudulent actions, stop account sharing, and protect the experience of hundreds of millions of users. You will manage the entire model lifecycle: raw behavioral data and feature engineering, architecture development, large-scale GPU training, deployment, and monitoring.
 The team is actively building in-house behavioral foundation models that learn identity-preserving representations from long sequences of user activity. This is a role for an engineer who wants to own deep learning systems end-to-end — not consume pre-built ones.
 Key Responsibilities Build and train deep learning models from scratch, including custom transformer and attention-based architectures for long behavioral event sequences.
 Own the full training stack: event tokenization, temporal and positional embeddings, self-supervised pretraining (e.g., masked modeling, contrastive learning), and downstream fine-tuning.
 Train large models efficiently on GPU infrastructure using mixed-precision training, gradient accumulation/checkpointing, efficient attention, and distributed strategies (DDP, FSDP, or equivalent).
 Build and optimize feature pipelines on Databricks and Spark, transforming raw behavioral events into high-quality model inputs.
 Translate prototypes into production ML systems — scalable, reliable, and observable — and drive inference performance through architectural and serving-side optimization.
 Contribute to MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, automated retraining, and production monitoring.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and platform teams; mentor junior engineers on experimentation rigor, deployment process, and responsible AI.
 Stay current with advances in ML/AI and bring relevant innovations into Adobe's products.
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or related field.
 5+ years of professional experience building and deploying ML solutions at scale.
 Strong programming expertise in Python, with hands-on experience in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.
 Deep understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle—from data collection to deployment and monitoring.
 Strong grasp of model optimization, inference efficiency, and production system integration.

 Experience in fraud detection, anomaly detection, or behavioral modeling.

Principal Scientist: Firefly Enterprise India   
 The Opportunity   
 Firefly Enterprise brings Adobe's generative AI and creative technology into the heart of enterprise content production by helping large organizations create, adapt, and deliver on-brand content at production scale, inside the tools their teams already use.  
 Our charter spans two areas:  
 Audio/Video Solutions: The media-processing backbone for enterprise-scale content production: ingesting, transforming, generating, and delivering audio and video reliably at production volume.

 We're looking for a Principal Scientist to be the technical anchor of a small, fast-growing team; a player-coach who is as comfortable in the architecture and the codebase as in a design review or a customer conversation.  
 This is a senior individual-contributor role. You won't carry direct reports or own headcount, but you will set the technical direction, raise the engineering bar, and mentor a team of software and machine-learning engineers. You'll partner closely with engineering managers on people leadership, and you'll be instrumental in interviewing and holding the hiring bar high.  
 Impact You'll Make   
 Set the long-term technical architecture and vision across both charter areas.  
 Make enterprise-scale reliability and resiliency a first-class property of everything the team ships.  
 Bring AI capabilities into the product and into how the team builds, raising both customer value and engineering velocity.  
 Grow a scaling team of software and machine-learning engineers through hands-on work and mentorship, i.e., lifting the technical bar by example.  
 Turn customer and field insight into a credible, deliverable roadmap in partnership with adjacent teams.  
 What You'll Do   
 Own the architecture for enterprise-scale audio/video media-processing pipelines by designing for throughput, latency, cost, and operational resilience at production volume.  
 Architect the extensibility platform : agentic enterprise workflows and plug-ins that expose Firefly's enterprise capabilities inside Figma and other Adobe creative apps.  
 Stay hands-on by writing code, leading design and architecture reviews, and setting the engineering standards the team builds to.  
 Mentor developers and specialists in machine learning alike, growing their technical judgment through the work.   
 Play an instrumental role in hiring: interview, calibrate, and keep the bar high.   
 Interface directly with customers and field/sales teams to identify real problems and collaborate across adjacent teams to shape the roadmap and deliver solutions.  
 Manage collaborators and expectations across engineering, product, and the field; with clarity and follow-through.  
 Leverage AI capabilities to improve both what customers get and how the team develops software.  
 What You'll Bring   
 15+ years building large-scale distributed software systems.  
 Proven experience operating at enterprise scale with a deep focus on reliability and resiliency .  
 Strong backend engineering in Java, Python, or comparable technologies, with a solid command of distributed systems and cloud-native platforms.  
 Experience with at least one of the team's two domains, and the ability to ramp on the other:   
 Media processing: audio/video pipelines, transcoding, streaming, or large-scale media workflows.  
 Extensibility: SDKs, plug-in architectures, integration frameworks, or agentic systems.  
 A track record of mentoring both software engineers and machine-learning engineers and raising the technical bar across a team.  
 Comfort working directly with customers and field/sales teams to translate problems into solutions.  
 Strong collaborator management with the ability to set expectations and align across engineering, product, and the field.  
 Excellent communication and the ability to make complex architecture legible to engineers, product leaders, and executives.  
 Preferred Qualifications   
 Experience employing AI capabilities for both customer-facing value and internal product development.  
 Familiarity with LLM application architectures, RAG, AI orchestration frameworks, MCP, or agentic systems.  
 Experience building integrations or plug-ins for Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Adobe Express, or comparable creative ecosystems.  
 Depth in enterprise-scale media processing, namely, codecs, streaming infrastructure, or GPU-accelerated media pipelines.  
 Familiarity with enterprise identity, security, governance, and compliance frameworks.  
 Contributions to open-source software or widely adopted developer platforms.

title: Enterprise Architect
desc:
Enterprise Architect 
 Position Summary
 As an Enterprise Architect at Adobe, you will build the future of digital experiences by helping global organizations unlock the full potential of data, AI, and cloud technologies. You will collaborate with executive leaders to develop transformation strategies, compose enterprise architecture roadmaps, and deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
 In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through complex digital, data, and AI transformations. You will build scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that connect customer data, intelligence, content, and activation across Adobe Experience Cloud and modern cloud ecosystems.
 You will influence strategic decisions, bring collaborators together around a shared vision, and help organizations accelerate innovation while delivering outstanding customer experiences.
 Success in this role is measured by the value you build for customers. It also depends on the quality and impact of your architectural leadership. Additionally, success includes the adoption of recommended solutions and the positive relationships you develop with executives and delivery teams.
 The Opportunity 
 Organizations are reimagining how they engage customers in an increasingly digital and technology-driven world. Adobe is at the forefront of this transformation, helping businesses build personalized, connected, and intelligent experiences at scale.
 As a member of Adobe’s Enterprise Architecture group, you will:
 Work alongside executives to establish approaches for digital experience, customer data, and AI transformation.
 Build enterprise architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation across the customer journey.
 Assist organizations in embracing cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures through Adobe Experience Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and major public cloud providers.
 Enable clients to accelerate innovation while reducing complexity and enhancing business value.
 This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-scale transformation initiatives, build technology strategy, and help clients achieve lasting competitive advantage.
 What You Will Do 
 Develop Digital, Data, and AI Strategy
 Collaborate with executive and senior partners to establish a clear vision for digital experiences, customer engagement, and AI-powered innovation.
 Translate business priorities into actionable, multi-year architecture roadmaps that align technology investments with strategic outcomes.
 See opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business performance by using data, AI, and personalization.
 Define success measures, value hypotheses, and benchmarks that guide investment decisions and demonstrate impact.
 Lead Enterprise Architecture Build 
 Build scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client technology ecosystems.
 Define modern data and AI architecture patterns, including customer data platforms, identity management, real-time decisioning, and personalization.
 Establish architecture standards and guidelines for cloud-native, API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based solutions.
 Develop reference architectures that enable agility, governance, security, and long-term scalability.
 Ensure architecture decisions support reliability, observability, performance, and business continuity.
 Drive Alignment and Transformation 
 Align business strategy, enterprise architecture, and delivery execution across marketing, technology, product, analytics, and data teams.
 Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes that enable balanced adoption and continuous improvement.
 Build positive relationships across client organizations, Adobe teams, and external partners to accelerate successful outcomes.
 Guide organizations through technology change while managing complexity and reducing risk.
 Influence and Encourage Communicate architecture vision, trade-offs, and recommendations with clarity and confidence to executive audiences.
 Lead strategy workshops, architecture reviews, and roadmap discussions that align collaborators and build momentum for transformation.
 Advocate for data-driven and AI-powered experiences that build measurable value for customers and businesses.
 Serve as a leader with a point of view who helps clients navigate new technologies and evolving market trends.
 Contribute to Adobe's Growth Build reusable frameworks, reference architectures, accelerators, and guidelines that strengthen Adobe's consulting capabilities.
 Mentor architects and consultants, encouraging a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
 Support strategic sales opportunities through solution building, executive presentations, and proposal development.
 Contribute to the evolution of Adobe's Enterprise Architecture practice and help build its strategic direction.
 What You Need to Succeed 
 Required Qualifications
 Proven success developing and leading enterprise architecture strategies for complex organizations.
 Deep expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks and integration patterns, including TOGAF, API-first, and architectures built on connecting different services.
 Experience crafting and delivering cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or comparable cloud platforms.
 Demonstrated experience crafting AI-enabled customer experiences and applying concepts such as large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, and model evaluation.
 Understanding of AI governance, agentic architectures, observability, reliability, and responsible AI practices in enterprise environments.
 Ability to translate business objectives into scalable technology strategies and architecture roadmaps.
 Strong executive communication and collaborator management skills,

desc:
Content Operations Lead, AI Studio Job Description 
 The Opportunity Adobe’s AI Studio is where the world’s leading brands bring their campaigns to life through generative AI; and behind every great campaign is an equally great production engine. As Content Operations Lead, you’ll be the operational backbone of that engine, working side by side with Creative Designers to keep projects on track, customers unblocked, and nothing falling through the cracks.
 This role is for someone who can walk into an unorganized customer situation, quickly make sense of what’s needed, and get the team delivering. You’re deeply comfortable with data (like wrangling CSVs, building Excel trackers, turning raw inputs into structured outputs), and you bring the kind of can-do energy that keeps teams moving even when timelines are tight.

 Quickly assess what’s needed from a customer brief or request — even when information is incomplete or unorganized — and get the team moving.
 Organize complex inputs from customers into clear, structured briefs and action plans that creative partners can complete immediately.
 Proactively identify and remove blockers so Creative Designers can stay focused on the work, not the logistics.
 Coordinate handoffs between Creative Designers, copywriters, and engagement managers to keep production on schedule.

 Work extensively in Excel and with CSV data to manage asset tracking, reporting, and production operations at scale. Strong spreadsheet fluency is essential in this role.
 Build, refine, and document production workflows and processes that increase team efficiency and reduce manual effort. Additionally, you will make sure they’re clearly defined and repeatable.
 Leverage project management platforms and AI-assisted workflows to streamline operations and keep interested parties informed.
 Find opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks and contribute to a growing library of team guidelines.
 Support Creative Quality and Output 
 Partner closely with Creative Designers to organize and prepare assets, manage file structures, and ensure outputs are formatted correctly for each channel and format.
 Bring a creative eye to production — catching inconsistencies, flagging quality issues, and helping maintain brand standards across deliverables.
 Manage variant tracking and asset organization at scale across formats, channels, and campaign phases.
 Be the Team’s Connective Tissue 
 Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal coordination, keeping interested parties informed and aligned.
 Maintain a positive, resourceful presence that helps the team navigate competing priorities and shifting deadlines.
 Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people feel supported and set up to do their best work.
 What We’re Looking For 5+ years of experience in program management, marketing operations, creative production, or a related role. Agency, in-house, or studio environments all translate well.
 Demonstrated ability to quickly understand deliverables needed, organize ambiguous or incomplete information, and drive a team to execution.
 Strong data fluency: you’re deeply comfortable working in Excel and with CSV files, building and maintaining complex spreadsheets, and using data to drive clarity and decisions.
 Proven ability to define, document, and improve processes: you don’t just follow workflows, you build them.
 A track record of unblocking teams and ensuring timely delivery in fast paced, time-sensitive environments.
 Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong attention to detail and follow-through.
 A creative eye and genuine appreciation for design quality, even if you’re not the one pushing pixels.
 Familiarity with generative AI tools and an openness to integrating them into daily work.
 Strong communication skills: you keep people informed without over-communicating, and you know when to flag something versus just handle it.
 A can-do attitude and the kind of steady, positive energy that makes teams want to work with you.

desc:
The Senior Manager, GSS India- provides leadership and governance for ISOC and its expanding JAPAC support mandate, while strengthening regional incident readiness and business resilience. The role integrates security operations center governance, intelligence-led monitoring, Incident Management Team (IMT) preparedness, incident coordination, Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and continuous improvement into a coherent operating model.
This is a senior, critical leadership role with accountability for outcomes, readiness, governance, and cross-functional coordination. Day-to-day monitoring and control room execution remain with the ISOC operational leadership and analyst teams.
Key Responsibilities 
1. ISOC Leadership & Governance
• Provide end-to-end leadership and governance for ISOC performance, service delivery, operating procedures, service levels, escalation protocols, quality, and risk controls.
• Guide the evolution of ISOC as a scalable, intelligence-driven regional hub supporting India and JAPAC.
• Ensure effective 24x7 monitoring, triage, notification, escalation, incident documentation, and employee assistance support.
• Establish meaningful performance indicators, trend analysis, assurance reviews, and leadership reporting.
• Drive process standardization, technology enablement, automation, workforce capability, and continuous improvement in partnership with GSS Technology and Systems.
2. JAPAC Regional Support
• Lead the operational readiness and phased expansion of ISOC support for JAPAC, including service scope, coverage, handoffs, escalation pathways, and regional operating protocols.
• Work closely with the Regional Director, JAPAC, regional GSS leaders, and in-country stakeholders to align ISOC support with regional priorities and global GSS standards.
• Promote consistent regional situational awareness, risk monitoring, incident visibility, and timely escalation across
supported markets.
• Ensure ISOC regional support complements, and does not replace, local response ownership and country-specific
requirements.
3. Incident Management Team Readiness & Coordination
• Support the Regional GSS Lead in maintaining IMT readiness, governance, rosters, activation protocols, escalation criteria, and supporting documentation.
• Coordinate IMT preparedness activities, including periodic touchpoints, tabletop exercises, simulations, training, and lessons-learned reviews.
• Enable effective incident coordination through timely situational awareness, action tracking, Emergency Notification System support, meeting records, and stakeholder updates.
• Support After-Action Reviews and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
• Maintain alignment among the regional IMT, local Emergency Response Teams (ERTs), the Corporate Crisis Management
Team (CMT), GSOC, and ISOC.
4. Business Continuity & Operational Resilience
• Coordinate GSS India Business Continuity Planning requirements in alignment with 1-Adobe Enterprise Resilience (1-AER), enterprise BCP processes, and applicable Site Recovery Plans.
• Partner with business and functional stakeholders on Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), continuity plans, recovery priorities, and testing or assurance activities.
• Connect BCP, incident management, emergency response, and site recovery arrangements to support a coordinated response and recovery model.
• Maintain current, controlled, and audit-ready documentation, with clear ownership and remediation tracking.
• Identify resilience gaps, dependencies, and improvement opportunities and provide transparent reporting to leadership.
5. Cross-Functional Partnership
• Work as an integrated partner with India Security Operations, Security Systems & Technology, and Environmental Health & Safety / Safety leadership to ensure coordinated delivery across people, places, and technology.
• Partner with Site Operations and Safety teams during incidents, exercises, recovery activities, and operational readiness reviews.
• Build effective relationships with regional GSS leaders, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe Technology Services, Global Site Operations, Travel, and other subject matter experts.
• Clarify roles, decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths across partner functions to prevent duplication and strengthen accountability.
6. Governance, Reporting & Improvement
• Prepare concise executive briefings, dashboards, decision papers, and incident or resilience updates for India and regional leadership.
• Maintain SOPs, playbooks, control documentation, action trackers, and governance rhythms for the role portfolio.
• Use operational data, incident trends, exercise findings, and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and
investment needs.
• Support budget planning, supplier governance, workforce planning, audit actions, and capability development relevant to ISOC and resilience.
Key Working Relationships 
• Internal: Director, India Safety & Security; India Security Operations Lead; Security Systems & Technology Lead;
Environmental Health & Safety / Safety Lead; ISOC operational leadership and analysts.
• Regional: Regional Director, JAPAC; country and regional GSS leaders; GSOC; relevant JAPAC stakeholders.
• Cross-functional: Global Site Operations, Employee Experience, Employee Communications, Legal, Corporate Risk, Adobe
Technology Services, Travel, Enterprise Resilience, and other IMT members.
• External: Service providers and suppliers supporting ISOC, risk monitoring, emergency notification, continuity, and
specialist response capabilities.
Qualifications & Experience 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience; professional certifications in security, incident management, emergency management, or business continuity are preferred.

 Adobe Consulting is seeking an experienced Technical Architect to join our team and lead the delivery of next-generation digital experience solutions for enterprise customers.
 As the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem evolves towards AI-powered and agentic experiences, we are looking for an AEM Architect who combines strong expertise in Adobe Experience Manager with an understanding of emerging AI capabilities and their application to digital experiences.
 The role goes beyond traditional AEM architecture. You will work closely with enterprise customers to define technology strategies, modernize digital experience platforms, and adopt emerging solutions such as Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and AI-powered content experiences.

 What you'll do 
 AEM and Digital Experience Architecture 
 Be a recognized technical expert in Adobe Experience Manager, including AEM as a Cloud Service, Edge Delivery Services (EDS), Universal Editor and Document-based Authoring.
 Architect scalable, secure and high-performance digital experience solutions across CMS, DAM, personalization and composable architectures.
 Guide customers through modernization journeys, including migration from AEM 6.x, on-premise and other CMS platforms to AEM Cloud Service and EDS.
 Define architecture and engineering practices that improve performance, Core Web Vitals, scalability and content authoring productivity.

 Understand and drive the adoption of emerging Adobe AI and agentic capabilities, including Adobe Brand Concierge, AEM Co-worker and other AI-powered Experience Cloud solutions.
 Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI and Agentic AI to transform digital experiences and content operations.
 Architect solutions that integrate AI capabilities with existing AEM platforms, enterprise content, customer data and business systems.
 Guide customers on AI-powered content creation, personalization, asset management, content supply chain and workflow automation.
 Understand key AI architecture concepts such as LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, APIs and MCP integrations, and their application in enterprise solutions.
 Advise customers on responsible AI adoption, including security, data privacy, governance and brand safety.
