As a Software Engineer at Applied Materials, you’ll dive deep into ground-breaking technologies—like machine learning and AI—to craft novel software solutions that solve our customers’ high-value problems. Our Software Engineers are responsible for designing, prototyping, developing, and debugging software solutions for semiconductor equipment components and devices to ensure quality and functionality. You'll develop software documentation and test procedures, troubleshoot software problems, and communicate with internal customers to understand project requirements. As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.  
 Technical Lead - Software: 
 Build software that powers semiconductor manufacturing.
 We're looking for a Technical Lead who enjoys solving complex business and engineering problems, not just writing code.
 You will build software that drives semiconductor manufacturing automation, working closely with product teams, domain experts, customers, and engineers to deliver meaningful operational impact.
 This role is for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with sound technical judgement. Someone who can move comfortably across different layers of the system, understand the underlying business problem, and make pragmatic technology decisions that stand the test of time.
 If you’re excited by learning how the business works, challenging assumptions, simplifying complexity, and building high-quality systems end-to-end, we'd love to talk to you. 
 What you'll do 
 Lead the design and development of scalable, reliable software solutions for semiconductor manufacturing automation.
 Drive architecture and technical direction across services, making pragmatic technology choices based on scalability, reliability, simplicity, and maintainability.
 Work across the stack when needed, including frontend, backend, databases, messaging, infrastructure, Kubernetes configurations, agentic/AI-powered systems, and helm charts.
 Partner with product managers, customers, and domain experts to understand semiconductor manufacturing workflows and translate operational challenges into effective software solutions.
 Deliver solutions that improve manufacturing outcomes such as productivity, quality, throughput, automation, and operational efficiency.
 Mentor engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and code reviews.
 Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence.
 Influence product direction through technical judgement and growing domain expertise. 
 What we're looking for 
 Core engineering capabilities
 8+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production-grade systems.
 Strong foundations in software design, distributed systems, data structures, algorithms, and system architecture.
 Strong experience designing and building backend services using technologies such as Python, TypeScript, NestJS, or similar.
 Experience developing modern web applications using frameworks such as React or Angular.
 Experience selecting and working with relational and NoSQL databases based on application needs.
 Experience in data science, machine learning, reinforcement learning related projects
 Experience designing event-driven architectures and message-based systems.
 Experience deploying, operating, and troubleshooting applications on Kubernetes.
 Experience developing software for complex operational environments such as manufacturing automation, factory operations, industrial engineering, engineering workflows, or productivity platforms is a plus.
 Exposure to AI, machine learning, agentic systems, analytics, optimization, or simulation-based software solutions is a plus. 
 More importantly... 
 We value engineering judgement over experience with any specific technology.
 You should be able to:
 Select the right tool for the problem rather than forcing a favorite technology.
 Challenge complexity and simplify architectures where possible.
 Balance short-term delivery needs with long-term maintainability.
 Understand trade-offs and make pragmatic engineering decisions.
 Learn unfamiliar domains quickly and apply that understanding to product decisions. 
 You'll thrive here if you... 
 Are curious about how products create business value.
 Enjoy learning domain knowledge, not just technology.
 Take ownership beyond your immediate component or service.
 Can zoom out from implementation details and think at a system level.
 Care deeply about software quality, reliability, and customer outcomes.
 Prefer solving hard problems over working within narrowly defined boundaries.

 Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.

 Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you are responsible for developing and maintaining methods, operating sequences, and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, subassemblies, and final assemblies. You'll work closely with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and new products, and you'll use engineering principles to estimate and reduce manufacturing costs, improve product quality, determine time standards, and make recommendations for tooling and process requirements. Your expertise in lean principles, automation, and continuous improvement will be instrumental in driving operational excellence and achieving higher levels of productivity and cost-effectiveness. You'll develop and use test procedures, evaluate test results, and assess work methods, procedures, and policies to identify root cause issues and solutions that ensure operational success.  
 Engineering Change Engineer 
 ITPL, Bangalore 
 Shift Timing – 02:00 PM to 11:00 PM 
 General Profile:  Requires specialized in Packaging solution. Interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. Solves problems; takes a broad perspective to identify innovative solutions. Works independently, with guidance in only the most complex situations.
 Job Description: 
 EC Engineer is responsible for the development and management of the Engineering Change Order process for assigned groups and/or product families or lines from documentation of initial problem statement through implementation and execution of the engineering change. Mediates problems across division lines to remove barriers preventing effective implementation of engineering changes. Ensures rapid and efficient processing of ECOs, resulting in cost-effective change implementation.
 Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Prioritizes Review of ECOs and expedites release of ECO, in the implementation cycle.
 Review ECO's for content completeness, Structure of Bill of Material, customer impact (internal and external), organizational impact, and functional product impact
 Determines effect of ECOs on products and processes; adequately ascertains who needs to be included in the evaluation, disposition, assignment, definition, approval, and implementation of the ECO; routes ECOs.
 Coordinates with other impacted EC analysts; verifies that appropriate CIB (Change Implementation Board) members are included on the ECO based on Product Family, Product Line, Change Category, planner/buyer and product option tree, as applicable.
 Communicates issues logged with EC Analysts or EC engineers to ensure for correctness of the ECO
 Analyzes part structure to determine the scope / impact of product changes; conducts where-used searches.
 Trains / coaches ECO participants in their functional areas; advises ECO participants on possible solutions for ECO related problems, issues or situations; routinely mediates conflicts between ECO participants. Evaluates ECO process for continuous improvement opportunities; assists in KPI development and document the process.
 Regularly participates in ECO PM’s meetings. 
 Participates in projects; may lead a ECO CIB project.
 Reviewing ECOs and recommending material related changes through the Change Control Board, identifying ECO impacted kits and assemblies and updating ECO notification summary comments to reflect current status.
 Knowledge: 
 Knowledge of Engineering Change Order (ECO) processes, forms, instructions, and policies
 Knowledge of ECO roles and responsibilities.
 Knowledge of PDM and BOMs & item master theory.
 Knowledge of supplier manufacturing processes and the ability to engage with suppliers to resolve issues.
 Knowledge of manufacturing methods and materials to include basic lean philosophy and principles.
 Knowledge of safety procedures and cleanroom protocol.
 Knowledge of cross-cultural communications.
 Skills and Abilities: 
 Demonstrated ability to write and track ECOs.
 Good experience in GD&T
 Must have experience in UG NX
 Knowledge of design tools
 Exposure in Reverse Engineering
 Good BOM Management skills
 Exposed to detailing and drawing
 Expert in drawing Review
 Working Knowledge on different Engineering change management software packages like, Oracle, SAP etc.,
 Knowledge on PLM software like, TCE (Team Center Engineering), Wind chill.
 Demonstrated computer skills to include MS Office, Lotus Notes, Visio and/or other software / systems necessary for the performance of the job
 Project management skills: 
 Ability to work with Cross Functional Teams.
 Time management skills.
 Effective negotiation skills.
 Effective presentation skills.
 Functional Knowledge: 
 Demonstrates depth and/or breadth of expertise in own specialized discipline or field 
 Business Expertise
 Interpre

 We are seeking a highly motivated Senior Engineer to develop, calibrate, and optimize compact models for bulk CMOS, BJT, and LDMOS devices used in RF, analog, automotive, and high-voltage applications. The successful candidate will combine expertise in semiconductor device physics, compact modeling, and AI/ML techniques to develop next-generation modeling methodologies and automation workflows. This position is part of Analog Devices’ Engineering Enablement organization based in Bangalore, India.

The engineer will also be responsible for building and applying machine‑learning‑based modeling methodologies. This role combines device characterization, compact model development, and machine-learning methodologies to address challenging semiconductor modeling problems and improve modeling productivity. 
 Our global device‑modeling team consists of approximately 20 engineers located across various ADI sites. We are a diverse group of talented professionals, serving as the critical link between the process development teams and circuit designers. The team offers excellent opportunities for technical growth, innovation, and collaboration across global ADI organizations. 
 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 
 Develop, enhance, and maintain compact models for CMOS, BJT, and LDMOS devices. 
 Create semiconductor device compact models for SPICE simulators. 
 Validate and correlate compact models against measured device data. 
 Debug and resolve convergence challenges encountered during circuit simulations. 
 Develop deep‑learning–based methods for parameter extraction and optimization. 
 Apply machine learning workflows to accelerate the parameter‑extraction process. 
 Build scripting tools to automate extraction tasks and generate reports. 
 Produce comprehensive reports summarizing project results and findings. 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Ph.D. in Semiconductor Device Physics, Characterization, Modeling, or a related field. 
 Skilled in optimization algorithms, data correlation, and automated extraction processes. 
 Strong analytical skills, execution mindset, and sense of urgency 
 Ability to collaborate across process, modeling, and PDK teams 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with semiconductor device characterization and measurement techniques. 
 Experience with Python and Verilog-A programming 
 Experience developing deep-learning, neural-network, and scientific machine-learning solutions using modern frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

 Analog Devices is seeking Digital Design Principal Verification Engineer , who will be responsible for design verification of highly integrated solutions and products in a multifunctional team. You will be working on driving real revenue growth on the next generation of Intelligence at the Edge products across multiple products and business units. 
 About ADI : 
 Analog Devices, Inc . is a leading global high-performance analog technology company dedicated to solving our customers' most complex engineering challenges. We play a critical role at the intersection of the physical and digital world by providing the building blocks to sense, measure, interpret, connect, and power devices and systems. We design, manufacture, test, and market a broad portfolio of solutions, including integrated circuits (ICs), software and subsystems that leverage high-performance analog, mixed-signal and digital signal processing technologies. We embrace a culture of innovation and collaboration to push the state of the art. 
 About the Role 
 Lead design verification team for SOC or subsystem design pre silicon verification.  The candidate will be responsible for formulating verification strategies, Define verification architecture, Flow, Methodology and leading, driving and completing verification of large integrated products. As a senior team member, it is expected that he/she will lead and influence verification methodologies within both DBU and ADI.   The candidate is also encouraged to participate in cross company technical initiatives as well as patent and publish work where possible. 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end SoC verification for complex digital SoCs, driving execution from planning to signoff. 
 Verify complex microprocessor-based designs, AI/ML accelerators, and high-speed peripherals using advanced verification methodologies. 
 Define and drive team execution by planning tasks, tracking progress, and providing technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance. 
 Collaborate closely with architecture and design teams to define requirements and align on verification deliverables and dependencies. 
 Drive pre-silicon readiness by aligning with emulation, FPGA, and software teams to cover post-silicon validation scenarios early. 
 Develop and execute end-to-end system-level use cases for comprehensive functional validation. 
 Architect and implement scalable UVM-based testbenches, DV flows, and methodologies. 
 Define and review test plans; ensure closure of functional and code coverage across block, subsystem, and SoC levels. 
 Work cross-functionally with emulation, FPGA, firmware, and system teams to ensure full-system correctness. 
 Apply formal verification techniques for IP and subsystem-level validation. 
 Lead NoC/interconnect verification and ensure robust data flow across the SoC. 
 Perform performance verification and system-level analysis across real-world use cases. 
 Drive innovation in verification strategies to meet aggressive schedules and quality goals. 
 Define overall verification strategy based on product requirements and design specifications, leveraging modern techniques such as formal, emulation, portable stimulus, and virtual platforms. 
 Requirements 
 B.Tech/M.Tech with 12+ years of experience in digital pre-silicon verification, including leadership across IP, subsystem, or SoC-level DV. 
 Strong understanding of SoC/Subsystem architectures with hands-on expertise in Verilog/SystemVerilog and UVM-based testbench development, debugging, and methodology implementation.

title: Lead Software Engineer
desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. Position: Lead Software Engineer (Python API/agentic)
 Location: Noida
 Experience: 4-6 Years
 Job Overview:   Cadence Design Systems is seeking a  Lead Software Engineer  to help lead the GUI and core workflow architecture for  Quantus Insight , our next-generation parasitic extraction platform. Built from scratch less than four years ago, this modern codebase offers a rare EDA environment:  minimal legacy burden  with significant opportunities for greenfield project work. 
 Based in the Quantus Insight R&D (Digital & Signoff Group), you will collaborate closely with leadership to design the application architecture using the  Qt Framework  and optimize the core structures supporting it. Because our databases frequently exceed one billion elements, you will solve complex scalability challenges by designing highly optimized, multi-threaded workflows with UI support that maintain high performance under heavy data loads. 
 This position also offers the opportunity to integrate Agentic AI workflows, transitioning a standard desktop GUI into an AI-assisted development environment. Backed by strong internal investment and access to advanced models, this role allows you to develop skills in LLM workflows while shaping technology used to design electronic devices worldwide. 
 Job Responsibilities:  
 1. Architecture & Design (Core Engine & Workflow)  
 High-Load Dataflow & Workflow Engineering : Design, organize, and standardize robust internal dataflows, defining how massive datasets smoothly migrate between the computational backend and downstream platform workflows. 
 Core Optimization:  Architect high-performance, UI-agnostic core structures and algorithms to optimize data throughput, memory footprints, and heavy computation cycles. 
 Asynchronous Multi-Threading:  Implement advanced multi-threading and parallel processing patterns to isolate heavy background database operations from the application's interactive layers. 
 2. Agentic AI Integration  
 Workflow Composition:  Compose and orchestrate our existing system functionalities and APIs into a unified, next-generation AI-native workflow. 
 LLM Integration:  Expose internal application states, core structures, and tool operations via clean programmatic interfaces accessible to LLMs. 
 Dynamic UI Syncing:  Ensure that autonomous actions, modifications, and state changes executed by the AI agent are instantly reflected and dynamically updated within the Qt user interface. 
 End-to-End Automation:  Help shape a system where AI acts as an autonomous active user—capable of running verification checks, interpreting results, and programmatically driving the software. 
 3. GUI Development (Qt Framework)  
 Widgets Implementation:  Drive the hands-on development and implementation of the Quantus Insight graphical user interface using C++ and the  Qt Widgets  framework. 
 Big Data Presentation:  Build and customize high-scale Qt Model/View components (trees, tables, forms) optimized for lazy loading, data paging, and minimal memory overhead. 
 Linux Environment Profiling:  Deeply profile, debug (using GDB/Valgrind), and tune UI performance under extreme memory and CPU utilization in Linux desktop environments. 
 Job Qualifications & Experience  
 Education:  Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 Experience:  4+ years of professional software development experience (or 5+ years with an advanced degree) focused on complex desktop application UIs. 
 Required Skills:                 
 Expert C++:  Deep proficiency in modern C++ (C++ 17 or newer) including STL 
 High-Performance Computing:  Proven track record in multi-threading, parallel programming, and data structure optimization. 
 Linux Expertise:  Advanced development, debugging (GDB, Valgrind), and performance profiling in Linux environments. 
 Software Engineering:  Strong grasp of object-oriented design, design patterns, and the full Software Development Life Cycle. 
 Scripting:  Proficient in Python for automation and tool integration. 
 Additional  Skills/Preferences:                 
 QT Framework:  Experience with the Qt framework for GUI development is a big plus. 
 EDA Experience:  Knowledge of parasitic extraction, layout connectivity, or physical verification. 
 AI/LLM Application (Experienced or Aspiring):  Hands-on experience building agentic workflows or working with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) is highly desirable; however , a strong personal interest, hobbyist experimentation, and a willingness to learn  how to apply AI concepts to core software engineering workflows will work perfectly.

desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. Job responsibilities: 
 Perform Product Engineering work for Genus Synthesis Solution (Genus), a logic synthesis software used for synthesizing a design described in a high-level language into logic gates, to achieve best-in-class Power, Performance & Area (PPA) for latest digital ASICs
 Understand the internal flow within the Genus for newly developed features and verify the correctness and perform experiments to determine an optimal solution
 Solve new and challenging problems in physical aware synthesis space with the goal to bridge the gap between logic synthesis and place and route
 Support the field engineers in Cadence Design Systems, Inc. and its customers in using Genus. In addition, interface between R&D and customer as the first line of support for the R&D and the customers
 Provide support to verify the interoperability of Genus with other digital logic software tools within Cadence Design Systems, Inc. to provide seamless flows
 Understand the future requirements of the software by interfacing with the internal and external customers of Genus and document the Product Requirement Specifications (PRS) for newly developed features using the standard documentation software
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in design and EDA with an emphasis on Cadence tools of Synthesis, Physical Design & timing closure at 20nm or below nodes
 Prior Designer, Product Engineering or Application Engineering experience in digital implementation, especially synthesis
 Understand industry challenges in digital implementation & sign off domain with exposure to 28nm & below foundry process nodes
 Industry experience with EDA tools in the IC digital implementation flow, preferably on Genus and Innovus
 Experience in Logic Design and Synthesis, Formal Verification, Low Power design, Physical Design and Timing Closure for block level and top level designs
 Automation skills using Perl, Tcl and shell scripting essential
 Knowledge of HDL – Verilog or System Verilog is preferred
 Must have logic design and timing closure skills
 Strong analysis skills required to debug complex timing closure, logical and physical design problems. Ability to perform root-cause analysis to suggest solutions to customers and provide feedback to R&D
 Qualifications 
 BE/BTech/ME/MS/MTech or equivalent
 We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

title: Senior Accountant
desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. The Revenue Accounting Shared Services team is a highly visible and process-driven team responsible for supporting accurate, timely, and compliant revenue accounting and reporting across global regions. The team supports month-end and quarter-end close activities, revenue reconciliations, journal entries, deal review support, audit requirements, and process standardization in line with applicable accounting standards. This role will support the global Revenue Accounting function and will report directly to the Manager of Shared Services team.
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 Support end-to-end Revenue Accounting activities within the Shared Services model for global business regions.
 Assist with monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, including preparation, review, and posting of journal entries.
 Perform revenue reconciliations between source systems, sub-ledgers, and the general ledger to ensure completeness and accuracy.
 Support revenue recognition activities in line with applicable accounting standards, including ASC 606 and IFRS 15.
 Review sales orders, contracts, invoices, and supporting documents to validate revenue accounting treatment.
 Coordinate with Sales, Order Management, Billing, Controllership, and regional Revenue Accounting teams to resolve revenue-related queries.
 Prepare and maintain revenue schedules, supporting workings, and close-related documentation.
 Investigate and resolve revenue variances, system exceptions, billing differences, and reconciliation breaks.
 Support internal, statutory, and external audit requirements by providing accurate documentation and timely explanations.
 Ensure adherence to SOPs, internal controls, revenue policies, and compliance requirements.
 Support transition, knowledge transfer, and stabilization activities for newly transitioned revenue accounting processes.
 Prepare and maintain SOPs for transitioned Revenue Accounting activities to ensure process consistency, clear ownership, control adherence, and seamless execution within the RA Shared Services team.
 Identify process improvement and automation opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency, and control effectiveness.
 Maintain proper process documentation, trackers, templates, and audit-ready records.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Postgraduate, preferably MBA Finance, or equivalent finance qualification
 4–6 years of relevant experience in Revenue Accounting, Revenue Recognition, or Finance Shared Services operations, preferably in an MNC environment.
 Good communication and stakeholder management skills to work with global region teams.
 Proficiency in MS Excel, advanced Excel functions, and reporting tools, knowledge of Macros and VBA will be an added advantage.
 Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven close environment with strong attention to accuracy and compliance.
 Hands-on experience with ERP and reporting systems such as SAP, SAP S4 Hana, SAP RAR Salesforce, Blackline, or similar tools.
 Knowledge of process improvement, automation, and standardization initiatives within finance operations.
 Possession of a valid US visa would be considered an added advantage.
 Key Competencies 
 Attention to detail
 Analytical thinking
 Process orientation
 Accountability and ownership
 Stakeholder collaboration
 Time management during close cycles
 Continuous improvement mindset

title: Lead Design Engineer
desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology. About the Role We are looking for a Lead Design Engineer to provide hands-on execution across Synthesis, LEC, CLP, and UPF/power-intent flows for advanced ASIC/SoC designs. This role is execution-focused with growing ownership: debugging synthesis and LEC issues independently, contributing to CLP sign-off, and writing constraints and ECO scripts, while working closely with the Team on complex escalations.

 Support CLP flows
 Write and maintain ECO scripts and timing/power constraints for design blocks
 Independently triage and document issues, escalating complex or systemic issues as needed.
 Collaborate with PD, DFT, and RTL teams to resolve cross-functional issues affecting synthesis/LEC/CLP closure
 Prepare clear status updates and technical summaries for internal tracking
 Required Skills 4–7 years of hands-on experience in ASIC synthesis, LEC, and/or low-power verification flows
 Working knowledge of Cadence Genus and Conformal (LEC and/or CLP)
 Familiarity with UPF/CPF-based power intent (IEEE 1801)
 Scripting proficiency in Tcl, Perl, or Python; comfortable in Unix/Linux based environments.
 Solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, STA basics, and low-power architecture concepts
 Strong communication skills and ability to work independently on assigned blocks

desc:

 Process Improvement & Project Representation: Drive continuous process improvements across cash, prepaid and expense accounting and reduce close cycle times.
 Conduct ad hoc financial analyses and actively contribute to management-led strategic projects and initiatives.

 Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field with a strong focus on accounting.

 Systems and analytical skills: Hands-on experience with an enterprise-grade ERP system and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a strong focus on financial controlling and process improvements. 
 Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with experience working effectively across global, cross-functional teams and internal business units. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, so you can present financial information clearly. 
 Work approach and adaptability: Ability to manage tight deadlines and prioritize tasks while staying highly organized, detailed, and accurate. A collaborative team player who is eager to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges in a dynamic environment.

title: Deployment Strategist
desc:
About the Team 
 The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.
 You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
 Role Description 
 As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
 You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
 This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
 The impact you will have 
 C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
 End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
 Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
 Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
 Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.
 What we look for 
 Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
 Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
 Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
 Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
 Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

title: Director of Engineering (Data Infrastructure)
desc:
(P-1490)
 Databricks processes petabytes of data and billions of transaction events daily - every cluster launch, every query executed, every dollar billed flows through infrastructure that must never fail. When we process billions in billing transactions with 99.999% accuracy requirements, when we ingest terabytes per second across 100+ regions, when a five-minute outage costs millions in revenue and customer trust - infrastructure isn't just important, it's existential. The next phase of our growth demands disaster recovery systems that prove reliability rather than hope for it, testing frameworks that catch production-scale problems before deployment, correctness guarantees that make billing errors structurally impossible, and automation that scales operations sublinearly with growth.
 In this leadership opportunity, you will build the data infrastructure organization that makes Databricks' continued growth possible. You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. This isn't about maintaining what exists; it's about architecting the infrastructure that enables Databricks to scale while reducing operational burden. desc:

 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for a Global Consolidations Manager to join our Global Accounting team based in India. This is a foundational hire  - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live.
 This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks.
 The impact you will have: 
 Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint.
 Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review.
 Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation.
 Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate.
 Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
 Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities.
 Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands.
 Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process.
 Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform.
 Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close.
 What we look for: 
 BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance.
 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework.
 A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory. 
 Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred.
 SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized.
 Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
 Experience with FX translation, functional currency assessment, and CTA accounting across complex international structures.
 Proven track record driving automation and process improvement in consolidation or close operations.
 Experience supporting external audits and SOX compliance in a consolidation context.
 Proven experience partnering with remote teams across different geographic areas, including with US-based accounting leadership, and the flexibility to support close timelines that span US Pacific Time hours.

title: SAP Functional SME
desc:
GAQ226R76
 About Databricks 
 At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.
 We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role,  you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience.
 The Opportunity 
 SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale.
 What You'll Do 
 Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible.
 Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short.
 Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements.
 Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer.
 Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI.
 Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features.
 Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives.
 Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship.
 What You Bring 
 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance.
 Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements.
 Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process.
 AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight.
 Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models.
 Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them.
 Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value.
 Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional

 At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.
 We're looking for a SAP Developer to build the applications, extensions, and integrations that bring this vision to life. In this role, you'll write clean-core extensions on SAP BTP, build full-stack apps and Fiori experiences, wire up integrations between SAP and the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, and help embed AI and agentic capabilities directly into finance workflows. You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI—shipping software that makes finance operations faster, smarter, and more automated.
 The Opportunity 
 SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As an SAP Developer, you'll be hands-on-keyboard building the layer that makes those processes intelligent: side-by-side extensions on BTP, event-driven integrations into the Lakehouse, and AI-assisted workflows that automate routine work and guide users through exceptions and approvals. You'll build with modern SAP and Databricks AI tooling—combining SAP’s core ERP capabilities with Databricks-native AI, agentic applications, and automation—while keeping the SAP digital core clean, scalable, and upgradable.  6+ years of SAP development experience , with hands-on delivery of at least one end-to-end SAP solution (an S/4HANA extension, a CAP or RAP app on BTP with Fiori, or an Integration Suite flow) in production.
 Modern ABAP: Strong command of ABAP Cloud, ABAP CDS, and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), plus OData (v2/v4).
 SAP BTP: Working-to-advanced experience with BTP runtimes, core services (Connectivity, Destination, XSUAA/auth), and deploying, securing, and operating apps on the platform.
 Front End: Solid experience with SAP Fiori concepts, SAPUI5, and Fiori Elements (OData v4).
 Integration: Experience with SAP Integration Suite / API Management and event-driven patterns (OData/REST, IDoc, Cloud Integration, Event Mesh) across hybrid landscapes.
 AI Fluency: Strong understanding of SAP and Databricks AI capabilities, with practical knowledge of generative AI and agentic concepts—including RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, tool calling, and enterprise AI governance. Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications and workflows on Databricks and integrating them with SAP is a strong plus.
 Engineering Practice: Comfort with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern dev tooling (VS Code, ABAP Development Tools in Eclipse, MTA/CF packaging).
 Clean-Core Mindset: Understanding of clean-core principles and why extensions belong side-by-side or in-app rather than in the digital core.
 Collaboration: Clear communicator who can work across functional, product, and engineering teams and take ownership of what they ship.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Domain knowledge in finance, procurement, or supply chain that speeds delivery and requirements understanding.
 Experience extending or customizing Joule agents via SAP Build / Joule Studio, or building agents on SAP AI Foundation.
 Experience building applications on modern data platforms (such as Databricks) that extend or sit alongside SAP.
 Cloud-native experience—containerization and Kubernetes (Kyma), observability, and scalability patterns.
 SAP certification in ABAP, SAP BTP, or SAP Build, and prior work in a high-growth technolo

 Key Characteristics
 As an executive engineering individual contributor at Databricks, you will have full ownership of the product or infrastructure direction in a major area, driving it from initial development to scalable solutions with clear business impact. You will serve as a force multiplier by elevating stability, reliability, and organizational processes, while bringing deep expertise in large-scale distributed systems. title: Senior Staff Software Engineer- Search Quality
desc:
P-1408
 The Mission 
 We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization’s data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight.
 The Role : 
 As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company.
 You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users":
 The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren’t trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed  to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions.
 The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces.
 The Technical Challenge 
 This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form:
 Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent).
 Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context.
 High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality.
 Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics.
 Why This is the Place to Be 
 You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let’s talk.
 What We’re Looking For 
 The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms.
 The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K).
 The Bridge Builder: You’re excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

desc:

 We are seeking a highly skilled Frontline Senior Technical Solutions Engineer with over 7+ years of experience to join our Platform Support team.  Innovation and Improvement: Stay abreast of industry trends and advancements in Databricks technology. Propose and drive initiatives to enhance platform capabilities and support processes.

 Qualifications:

Strong capabilities in designing and managing data pipelines, distributed computing are required.  Problem-Solving: Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues with a strong analytical and methodical approach.
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Customer Focus: Proven experience in managing high-impact customer interactions and ensuring a positive customer experience.
 Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in a team environment, collaborating with engineering, product, and customer-facing teams.
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree or relevant certifications are highly desirable.

 Experience with additional big data tools and technologies such as Hadoop, Kafka, or NoSQL databases.

 Understanding of data governance and compliance requirements.

desc:

 At Databricks Information Technology, we are a product-led organisation transforming the way we work, from how easy it is to use our IT services to the applications we develop to help us scale seamlessly amid incredible growth.
 As an IT Software Engineer (Infrastructure) , you will be a core technical contributor on the IT CorpEng Infrastructure team, owning and driving the evolution of our core infrastructure and observability platforms. This role requires a strong software engineering mindset, deep technical breadth across SRE and infrastructure worlds, and the ability to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for currently "immature" system problems. You will be responsible for building resilient, scalable, and automated infrastructure that empowers our development teams. As a member of the team, you will bridge the gap between software engineering and systems architecture, ensuring our AWS environment is cost-optimised, secure, and highly available.

 Automate: Develop and deploy production-grade infrastructure on cloud platforms (AWS preferred) using Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or Pulumi.

 Software Engineering Expertise: 3–5 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python for scripting, automation, and tooling (required).

desc:
FEQ427R545
 As a Solutions Architect part of a Global Capability Center(GCC) focused Field Engineering team, you will shape the future of the Data and AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated Data and AI teams in the world, including Fortune 500 enterprises and global AI-forward SaaS customers operating globally. In this role, you will be deeply embedded with our named strategic accounts, serving as a trusted long-term technical advisor while also collaborating with internal sales, product, and engineering teams.
 You will help our customers achieve tangible data-driven outcomes through the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in data engineering, analytics, AI and data science.
 Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic global prospects and customers, partner with regional field teams across geographies, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.
 The impact you will have 
 Be the trusted technical advisor for one or more named strategic accounts — building deep, durable relationships with their data, AI/ML, and platform engineering leaders, and earning a seat at the table for their most important architectural decisions.
 Help shape and drive your customer's AI strategy — partnering with their data science, ML, and AI platform teams to design GenAI and ML architectures, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and turn AI ambitions into production systems deployed on  Databricks.
 Partner with the sales team and provide hands-on technical leadership to help large enterprise  customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems across the full data and AI lifecycle.
 Consult on modern Lakehouse architectures and implement proofs of concept for strategic projects spanning data engineering, data warehousing, machine learning, GenAI— including validating integrations with cloud services, in-house tools, and third-party applications.
 Work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
 Collaborate across regions with fellow Solutions Architects and account teams, supporting our customers with consistent architectural guidance across their international footprint.
 Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks-inspired open-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) across the developer community.
 What we look for 
 12+ years in data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or a similar pre-sales / consulting role.
 8+ years hands-on experience with Big Data and AI technologies, including Apache Spark™, data engineering, data science, and modern AI/ML workloads.
 Strong hands-on architectural experience — able to whiteboard, design, and personally build end-to-end solutions, not just advise.
 Demonstrated experience working with large enterprise or Fortune 500 customers; experience supporting global accounts across multiple geographies strongly preferred.

 We're looking for a Senior Recruiter to be the driving force behind hiring the technical talent that powers our go-to-market engine across India — Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and the broader Field Engineering org. Your job is to find them, win them, and close them.

We're scaling fast, the bar is high, and the demand for elite technical pre-sales and field talent has never been more intense. title: Staff Software Engineer- Search Quality
desc:
P-1408
 The Mission 
 We are democratizing Data and AI for every enterprise user. Our vision is a world where anyone can master their organization’s data through Apps and AI Agents. We are building the retrieval backbone for two worlds: the high-precision context layer for AI agents and the intuitive search experience for people goal is the same: instant, accurate, and actionable insight.
 The Role : 
 As a Search Quality Engineer, you sit at the heart of this transformation. You aren't just building a search engine; you are building the contextual backbone of the entire company.
 You will own the quality of results for two distinct but deeply connected "users":
 The AI Agent: Optimizing the retrieval layer that allows LLMs to reason over data they weren’t trained on, ensuring they have the "ground truth" needed  to synthesize accurate, high-stakes business actions.
 The Human User: Improving the traditional search experience so employees can find assets and answers through intuitive, high-recall interfaces.
 The Technical Challenge 
 This isn't a solved problem. You will be tackling "Search" in its most evolved form:
 Hybrid Retrieval: Balancing traditional keyword-based search (for exactness) with semantic vector search (for intent).
 Dual-Optimization: Fine-tuning ranking models that satisfy both human readability and LLM-ready context.
 High-Stakes Accuracy: In a world of Agents, poor search quality leads to hallucinations. You will build the guardrails and relevance scoring that ensure our AI stays grounded in reality.
 Data Heterogeneity: Connecting the dots across structured SQL tables, unstructured docs, and real-time business metrics.
 Why This is the Place to Be 
 You will have a front-row seat to the Agentic revolution. If you want to solve the hardest problems in data discovery and see your work power the decision-making of thousands of people, let’s talk.
 What We’re Looking For 
 The IR Specialist: You know your way around Lucene/Elasticsearch, embeddings, and ranking algorithms.
 The Quality and Metrics Obsessive: You understand that "relevance" is subjective and love building evaluation frameworks (human-in-the-loop and LLM-based) to measure it. You are obsessed with relevance metrics (nDCG, MRR, Precision@K).
 The Bridge Builder: You’re excited to apply traditional Information Retrieval (IR) wisdom to the cutting-edge world of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

title: Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention
desc:
Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention 
 The Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention  is responsible for reducing churn, improving customer health, and protecting recurring revenue through early risk detection, cross‑functional mitigation, and scalable retention programs. The role partners closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Competitive Intelligence, and Pricing & Packaging to orchestrate coordinated customer‑save strategies.
 This role also provides renewal objection handling expertise , enabling teams to navigate downsells, downgrades, competitive threats, pricing pushback, TCO/ROI concerns, and budget constraints. The ideal candidate excels at influencing cross‑functional teams, handling commercial risk, and translating customer insights into save actions.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Churn Risk Identification & Health Intelligence 
 Maintain a standardized customer risk scoring framework leveraging health signals, product usage, support patterns, sentiment, and competitive exposure.
 Identify early risk indicators (e.g., discount cliffs, adoption gaps, under-deployed licenses, sponsor turnover).
 Partner with Renewal Ops, Data team to automate risk workflows in Salesforce
 Collaborate with Competitive Intelligence to map competitive displacement trends and update counter strategies.
 2. Cross‑Functional Risk Orchestration (Renewals, CS, CI, Pricing) 
 Lead weekly renewal risk reviews/war rooms with Renewals, CSMs/CEMs, and Sales to align on mitigation actions.
 Build account-level mitigation plans that include adoption interventions, executive alignment, value reinforcement, and commercial flexibility.
 Partner with Pricing & Packaging and Deal Desk to design controlled commercial offers (e.g., term/ramp, New Product Introductions, New SKU Impact, Product Bundling etc).
 Escalate systemic product, billing, or support issues and track resolution.
 3. Renewal Objection Handling  
 Serve as the subject‑matter expert for Renewals by providing guidance, playbooks, and strategic support to overcome critical renewal objections.
 Diagnose downsell and downgrade risks , recommend right‑sizing strategies, and deliver value‑based narratives to reinforce ROI and prevent unnecessary revenue loss.
 Partner with Competitive Intelligence to address competitive pricing challenges, coach teams on TCO and switching‑cost comparisons, and collaborate with Pricing on controlled incentive structures.
 Provide Renewals reps with ROI models, justification materials, payment‑flexibility options, pricing guardrails, and negotiation strategies to resolve budget and pricing objections while protecting retention revenue.
 4. Preemptive Retention Programs 
 Launch and manage proactive churn-prevention programs , such as:
 Early renewal health checks
 Competitive threat campaigns
 Discount cliff mitigation
 Develop and maintain risk playbooks for teams to execute consistently.
 Partner with Enablement to deliver training on objection handling and retention strategies.
 5. Insights, Reporting & Executive Readouts 
 Deliver monthly churn insights including root causes, save rates, objection trends, and program impact.
 Own cohort analyses, risk heatmaps, and retention dashboards.
 Provide actionable recommendations to Product, Pricing, Support, and Leadership teams.
 Support Renewal forecast accuracy through risk scoring and save probability modeling.
 6. Process, Tooling & Enablement 
 Improve CRM/CS tool workflows to enhance visibility into churn risk and save motions.
 Standardize processes for risk identification, objection handling, escalations, and mitigation SLAs.
 Build and maintain a knowledge base of objection-handling scripts , competitive counters, and case studies.
 Deliver enablement sessions to strengthen Renewals capabilities in handling commercial objections.
 Required Qualifications 
 8+ years in Renewals, Customer Success, Account Management, or Customer Operations (SaaS preferred).
 Strong analytical and commercial acumen with experience handling pricing, TCO, ROI, and competitive objections.
 Ability to influence cross-functional teams and lead risk discussions with executive stakeholders.
 Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight/CS platforms, and BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
 Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict‑resolution skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience in competitive intelligence, pricing strategy, or deal desk functions.
 Experience running war rooms or escalation workflows.
 Background in program management or enablement.
 Strong understanding of SaaS economics: GRR, NRR, churn, discount impact, unit economics.
 Key Metrics (KPIs) 
 Gross Renewal Rate(GRR)
 Net Renewal Rate (NRR)
 Revenue and logo churn rates
 Save rate on at‑risk renewals
 Early risk detection rate
 Renewal forecast accuracy
 Adoption/health score improvement
 Discount hygiene and cost-to-save efficiency
 Time-to-mitigation for escalated risks

title: Database Reliability Engineer/Database Engineer (Rubrik Security Cloud Platform)
desc:
About the Role 
 We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle. 
 What you'll do 
 Performance & Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines. 
 Disaster Recovery & Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores. 
 Storage Optimization & Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification. 
 Transactional Reliability & Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters. 
 Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery). 
 Infrastructure as Code & Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana) 
 Experience you'll need 
 Database Internals & RDBMS Fundamentals: 
 Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery). 
 Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures. 
 Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats). 
 Operational Database Experience: 
 4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL]. 
 Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots). 
 Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ 
 Systems & Kernel Engineering: 
 Strong Linux fundamentals: I/O subsystems, page cache vs. engine buffer pools, disk alignment, asynchronous I/O, and memory management. 
 Automation & Software Engineering: 
 Using  Python or Go for building database automation, operators, and CLI tooling. 
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration. 
 Preferred skills and qualifications 
 Hands-on administration and performance tuning of ClickHouse (cluster topologies, ZooKeeper/Keeper coordination, MergeTree engine family, mutations, and compaction). 
 Experience with change data capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, Kafka) feeding transactional updates into ClickHouse/Iceberg. 
 Experience managing lakehouse storage patterns using Apache Iceberg (metadata management, snapshot expiration, file compaction/orphan cleanup). 
 Experience with automated schema migration tools (e.g., gh-ost, Liquibase, Bytebase). 
 Familiarity with distributed consensus engines ( ClickHouse Keeper,Raft, Paxos).

title: Director, Corporate IT — Employee Experience & AI
desc:
About Rubrik 
 Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We’ve been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup.
 Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
 Job Introduction 
 Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket.
 We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee’s access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is “My Digital Twin”, an agentic layer carrying an employee’s full context alongside the organization’s memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs.
 This is a multi-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip.
 The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global.
 The environment 
 A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS and open source applications.
 Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc.
 Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc.
 VDI and remote desktop environments
 AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production
 ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management)
 Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc.
 Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms
 and others
 What you will be doing 
 Run the business: operational excellence today 
 Own the global end-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones.
 Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all-hands production.
 Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees.
 Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you.
 Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow-the-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites.
 Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area.
 Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits.
 Represent operations in cross-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy & Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps.
 Change the business: build toward ticketless 
 Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site.
 Re-architect hire-to-retire as event-driven rather than request-driven, so joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger provisioning, entitlements, device readiness, and access removal with no human in the loop.
 Build the organizational memory that “My Digital Twin” depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action.
 Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection.
 Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails.
 Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design.
