 Define and implement CI/CD patterns for platforms such as Salesforce, Zuora, and other Business Systems. 
 Establish environment and promotion strategies across development, test, staging, and production, including configuration management and deployment sequencing.
 Implement quality gates, automated checks, approvals, audit trails, and policy controls appropriate for enterprise application releases.
 Partner with application owners and development teams to define branching, versioning, release cadence, and rollback standards.
 Improve release observability through deployment dashboards, pipeline metrics, change records, notifications, and operational reporting.
 Investigate failed deployments and release issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions.
 Contribute to release calendars, change planning, blackout-period coordination, and risk-based release decision-making.
 Build documentation, runbooks, reusable templates, and enablement materials so teams can adopt consistent delivery practices.
 Coach engineers and application teams on GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD tools, release automation, trunk/branching strategies, testing, and operational readiness.

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science,Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
 7+ years of experience in release engineering, DevOps or a related discipline.
 Experience in Release & deployments for enterprise SaaS applications such as Salesforce, Zuora or Business Systems. 
 Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GitLab CI/CD or comparable CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
 Proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as Python, with the ability to write maintainable automation and integrations.
 Mandatory hands-on experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools such as Claude or comparable enterprise-approved tools as part of day-to-day DevOps and release engineering work.
 Experience with source control, branching and merging strategies, artifact management, automated testing, deployment orchestration, and rollback practices.
 Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication patterns, and integration troubleshooting.
 Experience managing releases across multiple environments with strong attention to configuration, dependencies, access controls, and auditability.
 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot pipeline failures, deployment issues, integration defects, and environment inconsistencies.
 Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, business, security, compliance, and operations teams.
 Enterprise application releases become more predictable, repeatable, and transparent.
 Manual deployment effort and avoidable release error

desc:

 An overview of this role 
 Help us build the next generation of authentication services at GitLab. As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Authentication team, you'll build authentication features across the Rails monolith and GATE. GATE is our new service for issuing and validating tokens and managing identities, designed to support every GitLab deployment model.
 You'll expand authentication mechanisms, including support for identities used by artificial intelligence (AI) agents. You'll also help keep GitLab and its customers secure by building access management tooling and addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
 GATE will become the foundation for token issuance, validation, and identity services across GitLab.com multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS), Self-Managed, Dedicated, and air-gapped environments. Your work will affect core components that customers, users, and GitLab teams rely on.
 Some of our projects include:
 Building GATE as the centralized service for token issuance and validation
 Consolidating tokens and migrating authentication paths out of the Rails monolith
 Building passkeys and passwordless authentication
 Developing composite identities that combine machine and human authorization for AI
 Improving service accounts and secure automation
 Enhancing Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) capabilities for automated user provisioning and single sign-on (SSO)
 What you'll do 
 Shape the roadmap for GATE and GitLab's authentication services with the team.
 Design and implement token issuance, validation, and identity services in Go and Ruby across the Rails monolith and GATE, including new authentication mechanisms such as Workload Identity Federation.
 Migrate authentication and token management paths from the monolith into GATE while maintaining reliability across all deployment models.
 Build authentication mechanisms from the ground up, such as Workload Identity Federation.
 Strengthen security for users and organizations through access management tooling and by addressing vulnerabilities reported through our HackerOne program.
 Define and improve standards for style, maintainability, and engineering practices in a high-scale environment, and advocate for them through code review.
 Communicate publicly about GitLab initiatives, projects, and contributions from people not working for GitLab Inc. Reflect GitLab's values in these communications.
 Ship moderately sized features and improvements with moderate guidance and support from other team members, and collaborate on larger projects, including the build-out of GATE.
 Participate in the maintainer trainee program at your own comfortable pace while working toward becoming a project maintainer.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
 What you'll bring 
 Professional experience with Go and/or Ruby in scaling or mission-critical SaaS products.
 Familiarity with authentication and authorization technologies or techniques, such as OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SSO, SCIM, LDAP, JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), role-based access control (RBAC), or identity and access management (IAM).
 Knowledge of token systems, cryptographic signing, and key management.
 Experience building or contributing to a service from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, and execution.
 Proficiency in written and verbal English, with the ability to communicate complex problems and solutions clearly in a remote, largely asynchronous work environment.
 Experience diagnosing, preventing, and resolving performance and optimization problems.
 Experience working in an iterative software development process, managing your work effectively, staying organized, and following through on priorities.
 About the team 
 Our mission is to empower GitLab system administrators with the toolkit they need to create their desired balance of security and accessibility for their GitLab experience.
 Authentication is the first impression a new customer has when they configure a new GitLab instance. We aim to make it as seamless as possible, from that first login to onboarding users and managing security rules for their instance in a secure, flexible, and scalable way.

 An overview of this role 
 As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.
 You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.
 Some examples of our projects:
 A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues 
 A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting 
 A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns 
 A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com 
 What you’ll do 
 Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.
 Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.
 Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.
 Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.
 Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.
 Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.
 What you’ll bring 
 Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.

 An overview of this role 
 We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer.
 This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives.
 What you'll do 
 Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion.
 Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them.
 Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage.
 Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD.
 Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services.
 Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback.
 Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers.
 Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
 What you'll bring 
 Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills.
 Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily.
 Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation.
 Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
 Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back.
 A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains.
 Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers.
 Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement.
 About the team 
 Every team in our organization owns its services end to end, from design through on-call.We own the control plane that tracks cells and decides where each request belongs, and keep the fleet in step with GitLab's release cadence.We work closely with delivery, database, migration, and product teams across GitLab. Feature teams own how their services behave on the platform; we own the underlying infrastructure.We're an all-remote, asynchronous team. We make decisions in GitLab issues, use directly responsible individuals (DRIs) to own technical direction, demo our work weekly, and use AI-assisted workflows every day.

 As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.
 In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. 
 Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.
 Some examples of the projects you could work on:
 Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
 Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
 Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)
 Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
 Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
 Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
 Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
 Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure
 What You’ll Do 
 Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
 Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
 Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
 Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
 Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
 Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.
 On Call Support: Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. 
 What You’ll Bring 
 Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.
 Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.
 Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.
 Programming & Code Analysis: Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.
 Large Scale Operations Background: Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.
 Architecture & Incident Response: Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.
 Customer-Focused Collaboration: Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitment

 An overview of this role 
 As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
 We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.
 Our projects include:
 OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells
 Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells
 Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith
 Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes
 What you'll do 
 Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.
 Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.
 Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.
 Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.
 Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.
 Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.
 Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.
 Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. 
 What you'll bring 
 Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.
 Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.
 Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).
 Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.
 A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.
 Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.
 Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.
 Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.
 About the team 
 The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for Git

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is The Role 
 We need a Marketing Technology Specialist for our APJ region. You will be the main contact for regional marketing teams. You will make sure they can use our tools for campaigns, events, and webinars. 
 Your work will cover three main areas: 
 Fix technical issues quickly. 
 Set up virtual events, live events, and mail campaigns. 
 Train users on our platforms so they can do tasks on their own. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Regional Contact: Be the main tech contact for the APJ region. Answer questions and fix system problems. 
 Events & Campaigns: Build and assist with virtual events and live events. You will be using tools such as ON24, Splash, Cvent, and Sendoso. 
 User Training: Teach regional teams how to use our tools. Show them best practices so they can work independently . 
 System Setup: Learn our different marketing tools, like Demandbase and Adobe Experience Manager. Work with the Marketo and Salesforce teams. Make sure data moves correctly between all systems. 
 Global Teamwork: Meet with global peers. Spot common issues in your region, share solutions, and create standard processes. 
 What You Bring 
 Hands-on experience with major marketing tools. You need to know event platforms (ON24, Splash, Cvent), giftin tools (Sendoso), and content systems (Adobe Experience Manager). 
 Knowledge of Marketo and Salesforce. You must know how outside tools send data to them. 
 Problem-solving skills. You like finding out why a process stopped or why data did not sync between systems. 
 A focus on the user. You can explain technical steps clearly to team members who are not technical. 
 The ability to manage multiple tasks at once and pay close attention to details. 
 Working hours that match the APJ region, plus time to talk with a global team. 
 Bonus Points 
 Certificates in Marketo, Salesforce, Cvent, Adobe Experience Manager, or ON24. 
 Past work with field marketing or demand generation teams in the APJ region.

 What is The Role 
 This role focuses on driving business intelligence and performance optimization across regional marketing initiatives by leveraging existing enterprise data products and reports developed by our core internal team. Rather than building new reporting infrastructure, this individual will serve as the expert user of established dashboards—analyzing results, diagnosing anomalies, and translating existing data into strategic insights. This position partners closely with regional marketing leaders to review performance and conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses that support marketing effectiveness , campaign ROI, and strategic decision-making. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Analyze global and regional marketing results using existing core dashboards and reports to identify underlying performance trends, growth drivers, and shifting data patterns. 
 Conduct ad-hoc deep-dive analyses using established data products to independently diagnose performance anomalies, tracking down the root causes of unexpected traffic spikes or pipeline drops. 
 Partner directly with regional marketing teams to build deep local business context, scope analytical requests, and translate standard dashboard data into actionable performance insights. 
 Synthesize complex datasets from existing reports into clear summaries, providing regional leadership with strategic recommendations rather than just surface-level data tracking. 
 Bridge the gap between data and strategy by proactively guiding cross-functional marketing partners on how to interpret existing dashboards to inform daily budget and campaign decisions. 
 Act as the expert user and champion of core reporting tools, funneling regional user requirements and data gaps back to the core internal dashboard-development team. 
 Audit regional performance metrics to ensure lead flow metrics, multi-touch attribution models, and conversion velocity data are accurately interpreted by stakeholders. 
 Communicate performance findings and diagnostic insights clearly to stakeholders across varying levels of technical and business fluency. 
 What You Bring 
 Solid business acumen with a deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, lead lifecycles, and pipeline mechanics. 
 Collaborative communication style with the confidence to facilitate stakeholder meetings, ask critical probing questions, and constructively challenge business assumptions. 
 Advanced diagnostic outlook with a proven ability to interpret patterns or anomalies in existing reports and form testable hypotheses. 
 Proactive and self-motivated problem-solver comfortable navigating ambiguous business requests and evolving regional execution models. 
 Data storytelling capability with a track record of translating analytical charts into simple, high-impact business narratives. 
 3–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, business intelligence, strategy consulting, or a highly analytical marketing operations role. 
 Proficient in dashboard interpretation skills, with deep experience navigating and extracting insights from enterprise BI tools (such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker). 
 Analytical skills including intermediate Excel/Google Sheets proficiency to manipulate, pivot, and model data extracted from existing reporting systems. 
 Hands-on experience navigating data models and pulling native reports within CRMs (Salesforce preferred) and major marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred).
 Basic SQL knowledge is preferred.

 Experience working with monitoring tools that integrate into service management.
 Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
 Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
desc:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
 What is the Role 
 You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
 That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
 Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
 Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
 Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
 Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
 Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
 Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
 Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice
 What You Bring 
 Elastic depth — non-negotiable 
 We are not looking for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
 Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
 Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
 Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
 Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
 Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
 More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
 Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
 Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
 Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
 A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
 Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

desc:

 What is the role 
 The Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) is the technical force multiplier of Elastic's partner ecosystem. Where an account Solutions Architect wins one deal at a time, you build the technical capacity of a focused portfolio of partners — system integrators, resellers, MSSPs and cloud providers — so they source pipeline, win deals and deliver Elastic without us in the room.
 The role rests on three pillars: drive growth with and through partners (partner-sourced pipeline); act as an architect of leverage (every partner engineer you certify adds technical selling capacity Elastic didn't have to hire); and co-innovate on repeatable solutions (joint blueprints, demos and partner-built offerings on our technology — including vertical and managed solutions Elastic doesn't build itself).
 This is a pre-sales role that carries a partner-sourced pipeline target. You will work a defined portfolio of managed partners, each with an agreed technical engagement plan, and be measured on outputs — partner sourced deals, committed engagement plans and published assets — not on activity volume.
 What you will be doing 
 Drive growth with and through partners 
 Generate approved partner deal registrations, jointly owned with Partner Managers for your territory.

 Accelerate partner-led opportunities, hands-on labs and proofs of concept, in collaboration with account AEs and SAs.
 Architect of leverage 
 Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders.
 Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner — the technical section of the Joint Business Plan — and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders.
 Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps — workshops, hands-on labs, accreditations, certifications — that move partners up a defined technical maturity model, from first knowledge to fully autonomous, market-leading practices.
 Co-innovate on repeatable solutions 
 Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, and distributors or MSPs.
 Back partner-built solutions on Elastic — vertical, sovereign and managed offerings that extend our product surface beyond what Elastic builds itself.
 Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts. Everything lands in a central repository for reuse across the ecosystem.
 How success is measured 
 We measure this role on four transparent objectives, reviewed quarterly with evidence: approved partner-sourced deal registrations against territory targets (the headline metric); execution of the partner sales playbooks that grow average deal size; committed and reviewed Technical Engagement Plans; and published repeatable assets. Pipeline and capacity, not activity.
 What you bring 
 7+ years in pre-sales, architecture, technology solutions, practice development, or consulting in the following technological domain (Security, Observability, AI). Security (SIEM) background is strongly preferred 
 3+ years of pre-sales experience in partner-facing ecosystems (channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSP/MSSP)

desc:

 What is The Role 
 The Elastic IT team is shifting beyond standard chat interfaces to craft the next frontier of generative and agentic AI experiences. We are looking for an innovative UX & Front End Engineer to join our team to bridge the gap between powerful AI capabilities and intuitive, delightful user interfaces that accelerate productivity across the entire organization. 
 Our ideal candidate is a skilled front-end engineer with hands-on experience designing and building AI user experiences (e.g., streaming text, dynamic prompt workflows, agent reasoning visualizations, and multi-modal interaction patterns). By shaping how enterprise users interact with generative AI, you will enable our global workforce while showcasing the boundary-pushing capabilities of Elastic's products. 
 Are you ready to design and build the interfaces that supercharge enterprise productivity and prove what’s possible with Elastic? Join us to create AI user experiences that turn collective knowledge into instant action, empowering everyone at Elastic to achieve more. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 AI UI/UX Design & Implementation: Translate complex generative and agentic AI processes into intuitive, responsive, and engaging front-end interfaces. 
 Front-End Architecture: Design, build, and maintain front-end UI component libraries. These libraries should be scalable, accessible, and reusable and will be created for generative AI interactions. You will use modern frameworks like React and TypeScript.

title: Account Development Representative
desc:
An Account Development Representative at MongoDB is the starting point for building a serious career in technology sales. 
 This role is the foundation of our sales organization. You will partner closely with Account Executives to identify new opportunities within strategic accounts, helping drive meaningful pipeline and long-term customer growth.  
 From day one, you will learn and apply structured sales frameworks including MEDDIC qualification, account mapping, multi-threading strategies, and value-based discovery. You will develop technical fluency across modern application architectures, cloud infrastructure, and database technologies, gaining real exposure to how complex software solutions are positioned and sold.
ADRs at MongoDB do more than generate meetings. They help shape early deal strategy, apply MEDDIC principles to qualify real business problems, and stay engaged through the scoping phase to maintain strong deal momentum 
 We invest heavily in structured onboarding, ongoing enablement, and consistent 1:1 coaching. Our ADR team is one of the primary talent pipelines into Account Executive and other revenue roles across MongoDB, with clear, performance-based progression paths.
 We believe skill development accelerates when teams collaborate in person.
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.
 What you’ll do 
 Own outbound prospecting within a defined set of strategic accounts, working closely with your aligned Account Executives and Sales stakeholders
 Research organizations to uncover new initiatives and opportunities where MongoDB can add value
 Execute thoughtful outbound outreach across phone, email, and social channels to generate qualified pipeline
 Lead structured discovery conversations to understand business priorities and technical environments
 Apply MEDDIC qualification principles to ensure high-quality opportunities before advancing them
 Stay engaged through the early stages of the sales cycle, contributing to strong handoffs and clean deal progression
 Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and sales engagement tools
 Consistently exceed monthly and quarterly opportunity targets
 We’re looking for someone with 
 Has a track record of setting goals and exceeding them in competitive or performance-driven environments
 Communicates clearly and confidently
 Takes ownership of outcomes and follows through on commitments
 Can manage a high level of outbound activity while maintaining quality and attention to detail
 Is coachable and actively applies feedback
 Learns technical concepts quickly and is curious about how businesses use technology
 Is serious about building a long-term career in technology sales
 Is comfortable initiating conversations with senior stakeholders and handling rejection professionally
 Things We Love 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Communications, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 Formal training or certifications in sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger) or technical disciplines
 Prior experience in sales, business development, or other quota-carrying/customer-facing roles
 Exposure to databases, cloud infrastructure, open-source technologies, or modern application development
 Experience using Salesforce and sales engagement platforms such as Outreach or Sales Navigator
 Why You Should Apply 
 Great earning potential
 Welcoming and inclusive workplace Meet MongoDB’s Employee Affinity Groups! 
 Continuous career development
 Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message
 Sales Bootcamp
 Buddy program cross-departmentally
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

title: Business Systems Analyst 3
desc:
We are seeking an experienced, techno-functional Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with broad experience across enterprise finance systems and processes, including accounting, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). The ideal candidate will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver system enhancements, integrations, automation, and process improvements across the finance function. The role requires an understanding of end-to-end finance processes, requirements gathering, functional configuration, integration design, testing, production support, and stakeholder management.
 1. Business Analysis and Process Management 
 Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements
 Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs
 Analyze and optimize end-to-end finance processes, including general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close
 Conduct fit-gap analysis and recommend scalable solutions aligned with business and compliance requirements
 Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirement reviews, and solution walkthroughs
 2. Integrations and Technical Collaboration 
 Work with integration developers to define interface requirements, data mappings, transformation rules, and error-handling mechanisms
 Support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP, flat files, and middleware or iPaaS platforms
 Analyze integration failures, data discrepancies, synchronization issues, and transaction errors
 Document interface specifications, field mappings, dependencies, and reconciliation procedures
 Collaborate with ERP teams, particularly NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle, to support financial postings and master data synchronization
 3. Testing, Deployment, and Production Support 
 Develop test scenarios, test cases, and test data for system enhancements and integrations
 Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
 Coordinate defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution with technical teams
 Support release management, deployment validation, and post-implementation stabilization
 Maintain functional documentation, configuration records, support procedures, and knowledge articles
 4. Governance, Controls, and Stakeholder Management 
 Ensure solutions align with internal controls, audit requirements, segregation of duties, and financial compliance standards
 Support access reviews, approval hierarchy validation, and audit evidence collection
 Manage incidents, service requests, and enhancement backlogs using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow
 Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and resolutions to business and technical stakeholders
 Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous process improvement
 Required Qualifications and Skills 
 6+ years of experience in business systems analysis, enterprise applications, or finance systems
 Strong techno-functional experience with enterprise finance systems
 Good understanding of core finance and accounting processes, such as general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close
 Experience gathering requirements and creating functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution documentation
 Practical understanding of APIs, integration patterns, data mapping, file-based interfaces, and troubleshooting
 Experience with functional testing, UAT coordination, defect management, and production support
 Familiarity with Finance systems such as NetSuite, Concur, COUPA etc
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills
 Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business users, developers, and integration teams
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with finance systems integrations involving ERP, CRM, billing, HR, banking, procurement, and other business platforms
 Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, API testing tools such as Postman, and integration monitoring
 Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-subsidiary, or global finance environments
 Knowledge of SOX controls, audit requirements, approval governance, and financial reconciliations
 Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, ServiceNow, and ITIL-based support processes
 Key Success Criteria 
 Accurate translation of business requirements into effective system solutions
 Reliable operation of finance systems business processes and integrations
 Reduced transaction errors, integration failures, and manual intervention
 Timely resolution of production issues and delivery of system enhancements
 Improved user experience, process efficiency, compliance, and audit readines

title: Manager Compliance
desc:
MongoDB is looking for a Manager, International Compliance to own statutory, regulatory, and corporate compliance for MongoDB's entities outside the US. This role sits at the intersection of Controllership, Legal, and Tax, ensuring MongoDB operates in full compliance with local corporate, tax, labor, and exchange control regulations across its international footprint, while supporting the broader global controllership agenda.  Ensure timely filing of statutory returns, registers, and disclosures across countries, coordinating with local advisors and in-country teams where needed
 Monitor changes in regulatory requirements across MongoDB's international markets and proactively assess impact on operations
 Maintain a compliance calendar and tracker spanning all applicable jurisdictions and statutes, with clear ownership and escalation paths

 Support local tax assessments, notices, and inquiries in coordination with external advisors

 Serve as a key point of contact for statutory auditors, internal auditors, and local tax authorities on international compliance matters
 Identify control gaps, document process narratives, and drive remediation in partnership with Controllership and Internal Audit

 Supervise and mentor a small compliance team, reviewing work product and building technical depth across jurisdictions
 Set priorities during peak filing cycles and manage workload across the team

 Partner closely with Legal on regulatory matters, licenses, and corporate approvals across international entities
 Work with HR on local labor law compliance, including statutory benefits, employment filings, and other country-specific employee-related obligations
 Support FP&A and Global Controllership with compliance-related reporting and risk assessments
 Act as the international compliance point of contact for global stakeholders navigating local regulatory requirements

 Support system implementations or process changes affecting international statutory and regulatory reporting

 8–10 years of progressive experience in international statutory compliance, corporate secretarial, or regulatory roles, with meaningful exposure to a multinational or SaaS/tech environment
 Strong working knowledge of corporate governance, exchange control, and compliance frameworks across multiple jurisdictions (India experience a plus)
 Experience liaising directly with regulators, statutory auditors, and external counsel across countries

title: Marketing Manager
desc:

We are seeking an innovative and collaborative Marketing Manager to execute key programs in India for select strategic accounts, coordinating across Global account plans with peers in EMEA and AMER 
 In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing 1:1 and 1:few Strategic Account Marketing plans to accelerate growth in our most important accounts that have a large developer and technical team presence in India.  We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Develop and execute strategic marketing programs for select Global accounts with developer arms in India.  We’re looking for someone with: 
 Educational and Professional Background:
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
 7+ years of account marketing, field marketing, industry marketing or sales experience in the Tech area.
 Experience working with large and complex Global enterprise accounts across multiple verticals including:  FSI, Manufacturing, Automotive Retail, and others, with a proven success record in planning and executing effective marketing programs
 Skills and Expertise:
 Experience with strategic 1:1 or 1:few account-based marketing, leveraging multi-channel tactics across digital and F2F.
 Experience working with cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), ISV, AI, and other tech partners.
 Incredible written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to sales and marketing leadership, as well as customers. 
 Impeccable event and project management skills, ensuring seamless planning, coordination, and delivery of initiatives with an ability to problem-solve quickly.
 Results-oriented and analytically skilled, capable of interpreting data, making informed data-driven decisions, and reporting insights to the business.
 AI-savvy with strong desire to understand and learn how AI tools and processes can be used in daily work.

 Experience working cross-functionally with enterprise or corporate sales, customer success teams, and account development teams, obsessing over addressable market and specific account goals.
 Capable of establishing credibility with sales partners to effectively convey marketing value propositions and key messages.

 Proficiency with Google Workspace and Salesforce, and marketing technology tools like 6sense, Eloqua, Pathfactory, Sigma, Tableau.
 Attributes and Work Style:
 Must be a highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial professional who can excel in an autonomous work environment and proactively drive initiatives.
 Ability to leverage data to inform decisions and strategic plans.

 Growth mindset and results-oriented
 Team ethos is made up of good humor, a positive can-do attitude, yet high standards and focused on impact.
 Time management, prioritization, and organizational skills are key.
 Additional Requirements:
 Proven experience working with Global teams and key APAC markets, including India, Vietnam, Thailand, and China.
 Travel as required.

 The Strategic Accounts Marketing Programs Manager will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:
 In 3 months you’ll have fostered a relationship with your Sales Account teams (ex: sales, solution architects, field partner leads, customer success) to understand their account priorities, begin planning marketing programs, and ramp on current account status and MongoDB product knowledge. 
 In 6 months you’ll have a clear understanding of your key objectives, have executed marketing activities with pipeline influence, and have started to become a trusted partner to your account stakeholders.

title: Senior Administrator - Business Systems
desc:
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in India for our hybrid working model.
 About MongoDB 
 The database market is massive, and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. The MongoDB community is transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing applications that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and continue to innovate at scale to support our customers and internal teams with world-class systems and experiences.
 About Team 
 IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in optimizing MongoDB sales processes, streamlining customer interactions, and maximizing the efficiency of our sales efforts. By leveraging Salesforce, the team ensures that business users have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support operational processes, and drive business growth.
 With deep expertise in Salesforce administration, platform governance, automation, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the Salesforce CRM platform to meet evolving business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
 What you’ll do 
 We are looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to manage and enhance the Salesforce CRM system supporting MongoDB’s Sales organization.
 Effectively work both autonomously and collaboratively across Salesforce platform administration, configuration, release support, security, and audit-related activities.
 Work closely with Tech Leads, Program Managers, Developers, DevOps teams, and Business Stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver scalable declarative solutions.
 Contribute across multiple functions including platform administration, CI/CD participation, release support, access governance, security improvements, and audit readiness.
 Ensure appropriate controls, documentation, and governance practices are followed to maintain a strong and effective control environment.
 Responsibilities 
 Administer, configure, and maintain the Salesforce platform, including users, roles, profiles, permission sets, sharing settings, page layouts, record types, and other core administrative functions.
 Build and enhance Salesforce solutions using declarative tools such as Flows, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, and page layouts.
 Support DevOps and CI/CD activities including deployment, validations, release readiness, environment coordination, and change migration across Salesforce environments.
 Participate in audit processes by supporting evidence collection, validating controls, documenting configurations, and helping close identified gaps.
 Maintain a strong understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, roles, permission sets, field-level security, object access, and sharing rules.
 Support platform stability and day-to-day operational activities by troubleshooting issues, resolving user requests, and maintaining data integrity.
 Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements, improve processes, and recommend scalable platform solutions.
 Maintain clear documentation for system configurations, release activities, controls, support procedures, and governance practices.
 Research platform capabilities, best practices, and new Salesforce features to continuously improve system effectiveness and administration maturity.
 Minimum Requirements 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent experience.
 8+ years of Salesforce Administration experience in a mid-to-large enterprise environment.
 Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator, Salesforce Certified App Builder, Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Salesforce Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer certifications are required.
 Familiarity with AI-powered and agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and similar platforms.
 Experience with DevOps and CI/CD tools such as Copado, Gearset, Git-based deployment workflows, or similar tools.
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
 Success Measures 
 In 3 months, you will have developed a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce platform, support model, security posture, release processes, and core business workflows by working closely with stakeholders and technical teams.
 In 6 months, you will have independently delivered multiple configuration-based enhancements, actively contributed to release and DevOps activities, and started driving improvements in platform governance, security, and operational efficiency.
 In 12 months, you will have become a trusted Salesforce platform owner who can confidently contribute across administration, declarative delivery, security reviews, audit readiness, and release support while helping strengthen the overall Salesforce operating model.

title: Senior Data Analyst
desc:
MongoDB’s Analytics team partners across go-to-market and Product to help the business make better decisions. We work with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product teams to connect data at a granular level, understand performance, and identify opportunities to improve how we operate.
 As a Senior Data Analyst, you’ll work with business and technical partners to frame questions, deliver reliable analysis, and translate findings into practical recommendations. You’ll contribute to analytics and reporting that make complex information easier to understand and act on.
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurgaon for our hybrid working model.
 What you’ll do 
 Partner with Sales, GTM Operations, FP&A, CRM Technology, and Product to understand business questions and shape them into clear analytical work
 Analyze business performance, including pipeline health, funnel movement, productivity, attainment, and other team priorities
 Write SQL analyses and build reusable datasets; use Python or R for data exploration, analysis, and automation
 Build and improve dashboards and reporting that help teams monitor performance and investigate changes
 Identify meaningful trends, risks, and opportunities; explain what the analysis does and does not show; and recommend next steps
 Work with data and systems partners to investigate quality issues, clarify definitions, and improve data reliability
 Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and follow through on whether recommendations are adopted
 What we’re looking for 
 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related field. We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and strong evidence of relevant skills and impact
 Strong SQL skills are required, including the ability to join and aggregate data, reason about metric definitions, and validate results
 Experience using Python or R for analysis and data manipulation is a plus
 Experience turning business questions into structured analysis and communicating findings to different audiences
 Familiarity with dashboards or data visualization tools; Tableau experience is helpful
 Good data judgment: you check assumptions and data quality, are transparent about limitations, and can distinguish a useful signal from noise
 A collaborative, dependable approach to working with business and technical partners, including when requirements are still taking shape
 Experience in SaaS, go-to-market, sales, finance, or product analytics is helpful, but not required

 Ability to prioritize and make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure

This role will lead core corporate accounting activities, global close execution, balance-sheet integrity, reconciliations, accounting operations, and process improvement across MongoDB’s multi-entity environment.
 The Senior Manager will partner closely with General Ledger, SEC Reporting, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, Tax, Internal Audit, and external auditors. The role is designed for an accounting leader who can combine strong operational judgment with disciplined execution, clear communication, and a process-improvement mindset.
 What you will do 
 Corporate accounting and global close 
 Lead and review corporate accounting activities across the monthly, quarterly, and annual close cycles
 Own the quality and timeliness of balance-sheet reconciliations, journal entries, account analyses, flux explanations, and other close deliverables
 Coordinate with global accounting teams to resolve variances, strengthen close procedures, and maintain consistent accounting practices across entities
 Support consolidation activities, intercompany accounting, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, leases, and other corporate accounting areas as assigned
 Partner with SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to provide accurate close data, schedules, and supporting documentation for external reporting and accounting conclusions
 Controls, audit, and process improvement 
 Maintain and strengthen accounting controls and support SOX activities, including control execution, evidence quality, process narratives, and remediation
 Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external auditors during walkthroughs, quarterly reviews, annual audits, and requests related to corporate accounting processes
 Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reduce manual effort, and increase automation across close and reconciliation processes
 Help implement scalable accounting policies, procedures, and documentation as MongoDB continues to grow
 Leadership and partnership 
 Lead, coach, and develop accounting professionals while setting clear expectations for quality, accountability, and continuous improvement
 Coordinate work across global accounting teams and help establish consistent processes across entities and reporting cycles
 Translate accounting issues into clear, practical guidance for Finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
 Build trusted relationships across the organization and represent Controllership with sound judgment and a service-oriented approach
 What you bring 
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including significant experience in corporate accounting, global close, or a related controllership function
 Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and corporate accounting processes in a public-company or similarly complex environment
 Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidations, intercompany activity, balance-sheet reconciliations, and close management
 Experience working in a SOX-controlled environment and partnering with internal and external auditors
 Experience leading, mentoring, or managing accounting professionals in a global organization
 Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
 Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate effectively during close and reporting cycles, and make sound decisions with incomplete information
 Experience with NetSuite, FloQast, Workiva, or similar accounting and reporting systems is preferred

title: Senior Manager, Regional Employee Experience

title: Senior Manager, Revenue
desc:
The Revenue team is a highly visible, global team responsible for accurate and timely revenue reporting. The team manages the monthly and quarterly revenue close, supports contract review and accounting conclusions, evaluates revenue treatment for new and existing product offerings, maintains controls over revenue reporting, and supports revenue forecasting and analytics.
 This role will lead the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, India, with responsibility for managing and developing Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts. The Senior Manager will be the primary point of leadership for the India Revenue Operations team and will be accountable for the quality and timely execution of the revenue processes owned by the team.
 The role will partner closely with global Revenue leadership and cross-functional teams to manage close execution, resolve complex revenue and operational issues, strengthen processes and controls, and continue building the capabilities of the India team.
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
 Candidate Profile 
 Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA, CA, or equivalent qualification preferred
 10+ years of relevant experience, including experience in revenue accounting or revenue operations at a public, high-growth SaaS or technology company
 Demonstrated people leadership experience, including managing Managers and individual contributors
 Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including experience with SaaS, cloud, and usage-based revenue models
 Experience owning complex revenue close processes, including revenue recognition, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue allocations, and related analytics
 Experience reviewing customer contracts and evaluating non-standard terms and revenue accounting considerations
 Strong understanding of financial reporting controls, SOX requirements, and external audit support
 Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex issues, determine appropriate next steps and escalation, and drive matters through resolution
 Experience improving or scaling accounting processes through standardization, automation, documentation, or enhanced controls
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to work with large data sets and identify trends, exceptions, and underlying drivers
 Experience with ERP and CRM systems; NetSuite and Salesforce experience preferred
 Advanced Excel skills
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, levels, and global time zones
 Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining a high degree of accuracy and sound judgment
 Position Expectations 
 Lead, manage, and develop the Revenue Operations team in Gurugram, including Revenue Managers and Revenue Analysts, with accountability for team performance, development, workload allocation, and effective delegation
 Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close activities within the India team's scope, including revenue analyses, journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition, and related review activities, ensuring accurate and timely completion
 Establish clear ownership, review, and escalation expectations across the team and ensure issues are identified and addressed on a timely basis
 Review complex sales transactions within the Company's ERP and revenue systems to ensure the accuracy of underlying data, revenue allocations, and revenue schedules
 Review contract analyses and provide guidance on revenue treatment for complex or non-standard arrangements under ASC 606 and the Company's accounting policies
 Apply judgment to revenue accounting and operational issues, determine when escalation is required, and drive issues to resolution in partnership with global Revenue leadership and other stakeholders
 Lead quarterly review and year-end audit activities for the revenue processes owned by the India team, including coordination of supporting documentation and resolution of auditor questions
 Review revenue analytics and complex data sets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential financial reporting or operational risks and communicate findings to Revenue leadership
 Partner with OTC, Legal, FP&A, Product, Cloud Engineering, FinTech, and other cross-functional teams on initiatives and issues with revenue accounting or operational implications
 Partner with global Revenue leadership to align processes, controls, and operating practices across the broader Revenue organization
 Identify and lead opportunities to improve the efficiency, scalability, and control environment of Revenue Operations through process improvement, automation, standardization, and documentation
 Coach Revenue Managers and Analysts to strengthen technical knowledge, operational ownership, judgment, and issue escalation
 Support new products, systems, and business initiatives by assessing revenue accounting and operational impacts and helping ensure appropriate processes and controls are established
 Lead revenue-related projects and other initiatives requiring coordination across the India Revenue team and global business partners
 Success Measures 
 First 30 Days
 A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of the Company's business, product offerings, revenue streams, key systems, close processes, controls, and team responsibilities, while establishing relationships with the Gurugram team and key global stakeholders
 3 to 6 Months
 The Senior Manager will be independently overseeing the revenue close activities within the India team's scope, with clear ownership and escalation expectations established across Revenue Managers and Analysts. The individual will also have identified key opportunities to improve processes, controls, documentation, and team capability
 6 to 9 Months
 The Senior Manager will be operating as a trusted partner to Revenue leadership and key cross-functional teams

title: Senior Platform Engineer
desc:
The Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining a self-service internal development platform that enables MongoDB engineering teams to reliably deploy and operate their own production services and products. We work with numerous engineering teams across the company to understand their infrastructure requirements and development workflows, develop broadly applicable self-service platform services and tooling, continuously monitor how platform services are being utilized, and look for ways to improve developer productivity through automation and education.
 We are big open source enthusiasts and use a number of open source tools in our stack (contributing upstream whenever possible). Some of the tools we use regularly include Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Crossplane, Terraform, Helm, Drone, Prometheus, and Grafana. However, technology is nothing without a stellar team of engineers that are focused on doing high quality work and working as a team to solve complex distributed computing and platform engineering problems. This is where you come in!
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
 Our ideal candidate 
 Has built and operated large-scale distributed systems in cloud providers (AWS strongly preferred).
 Has a strong backend programming background. Fluency in Go is strongly preferred; deep experience with another compiled or strongly-typed backend language is acceptable.
 Has experience working with AI coding agents and can demonstrate building high quality context to yield high quality outputs.
 Has experience designing and implementing medium-to-large software projects, including driving design reviews and mentoring less-senior engineers.
 Pragmatic, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and understands the benefits of collaboration.
 Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, not just deployed to it.
 Has practical experience defining and operating against SLI/SLOs for services they owned.
 Strong experience with observability tooling: metrics, logging, traces, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.
 Strong Linux and TCP/IP networking skills.
 Familiar with standard authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC).
 Familiar with web services and/or Kubernetes controller development.
 Strong experience using CI/CD workflows to deploy production services.
 Position Expectations 
 Work with engineering teams across MongoDB to investigate gaps and limitations in existing development workflows and understand new infrastructure and platform requirements.
 Design self-service platform services and developer tooling that focuses on reliability, usability, and provides the appropriate level of abstraction from cloud infrastructure.
 Regularly write and review automation, configuration management, and application code.
 Author and review functional specifications and scoping documents for large platform projects and services.
 Own and operate much of the internal development platform that runs MongoDB.
 Work on a distributed team that frequently interacts with remote engineers across multiple time zones (PST, EST, GMT, IST).
 Success Measures 
 In three months you'll have familiarized yourself with much of our environment and will be able to whiteboard important pieces of our platform on the fly. You will also be making regular contributions to our tooling/services and jumping in to help resolve incidents and respond to user requests.
 In six months you'll have successfully investigated, scoped, executed, and documented a medium to large sized platform project.
 In a year you'll have used your deep knowledge of our software and infrastructure to help drive platform adoption across the company. You will also be a subject matter expert in at least one component of our platform, and will have made a number of sizable contributions to our code base that significantly improve the quality, reliability and maintainability of our systems.

desc:

 You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.
 We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
 What you'll own 
 You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.

 Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Builder Experience (ABX)
desc:
AI agents are transforming the way developers interact with software - and databases are no exception. We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our AI Interfaces team within AI Builder Experience (ABX), where you'll provide technical direction, shape architecture, and build the core products that make it seamless for developers and AI agents to work with MongoDB. Our team owns the surfaces through which humans and agents connect to MongoDB - including the MongoDB MCP Server, Agent Skills, our Intelligent Assistant Platform, and purpose-built agents.
